```ts
function loadFromStorage<T>(key: string): T[] {

  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}
```

storage.ts:
```ts
import type { Goal, ScheduleEvent } from "./types";

const EVENTS_KEY = "tp.events.v1";
const GOALS_KEY = "tp.goals.v1";

function loadFromStorage<T>(key: string): T[] {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    return parsed as T[];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveToStorage<T>(key: string, list: T[]): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(list));
  } catch {
    // 忽略写入异常（如超出配额）
  }
}

export function loadEvents(): ScheduleEvent[] {
  return loadFromStorage<ScheduleEvent>(EVENTS_KEY);
}

export function saveEvents(list: ScheduleEvent[]): void {
  saveToStorage(EVENTS_KEY, list);
}

export function loadGoals(): Goal[] {
  return loadFromStorage<Goal>(GOALS_KEY);
}

export function saveGoals(list: Goal[]): void {
  saveToStorage(GOALS_KEY, list);
}
```

time.ts:
```ts
function pad2(n: number): string {
  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
}

export function minutesToLabel(minutes: number): string {
  const h = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  const m = minutes % 60;
  return `${pad2(h)}:${pad2(m)}`;
}

export function labelToMinutes(label: string): number {
  const [h, m] = label.split(":").map((part) => parseInt(part, 10));
  return h * 60 + m;
}

export function dateKey(date: Date): string {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const d = date.getDate();
  return `${y}-${pad2(m)}-${pad2(d)}`;
}

export function startOfWeek(d: Date): Date {
  const date = new Date(d);
  const day = date.getDay(); // 0=周日, 1=周一 ...
  const diff = (day + 6) % 7; // 距离周一的天数
  date.setDate(date.getDate() - diff);
  date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return date;
}

export function addDays(d: Date, n: number): Date {
  const date = new Date(d);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + n);
  return date;
}

export function formatWeekRange(weekStart: Date): string {
  const end = addDays(weekStart, 6);
  const month = weekStart.getMonth() + 1;
  const startDay = weekStart.getDate();
  const endDay = end.getDate();
  return `${month} 月 ${startDay} 日 - ${endDay} 日`;
}
```

```tsx
}
```

Let me now define the full WeekGrid component.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { addDays, dateKey, formatWeekRange, minutesToLabel } from "@/lib/time";

const HOUR_HEIGHT = 56;
const HOURS = 24;
const HEADER_HEIGHT = 56;

const WEEKDAY_LABELS = ["周日", "周一", "周二", "周三", "周四", "周五", "周六"];

const KIND_STYLES: Record<ScheduleEvent["kind"], string> = {
  course: "bg-blue-600",
  task: "bg-emerald-600",
  event: "bg-slate-500",
};

type WeekGridProps = {
  events: ScheduleEvent[];
  weekStart: Date;
  onSlotClick: (date: string, startMin: number) => void;
  onEventClick: (ev: ScheduleEvent) => void;
  flashIds?: string[];
  conflictIds?: string[];
};

export default function WeekGrid({
  events,
  weekStart: initialWeekStart,
  onSlotClick,
  onEventClick,
  flashIds,
  conflictIds,
}: WeekGridProps) {
  const [weekStart, setWeekStart] = useState(initialWeekStart);
  const [todayKey, setTodayKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setTodayKey(dateKey(new Date()));
  }, []);

  const days = useMemo(
    () => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(weekStart, i)),
    [weekStart],
  );

  const dateToIndex = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    days.forEach((d, i) => map.set(dateKey(d), i));
    return map;
  }, [days]);

  const flashSet = useMemo(() => new Set(flashIds ?? []), [flashIds]);
  const conflictSet = useMemo(() => new Set(conflictIds ?? []), [conflictIds]);

  const prevWeek = () => setWeekStart((w) => addDays(w, -7));
  const nextWeek = () => setWeekStart((w) => addDays(w, 7));

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col">
      {/* toolbar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
        <button onClick={prevWeek} className="...">← 上一周</button>
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">{formatWeekRange(weekStart)}</span>
        <button onClick={nextWeek} className="...">下一周 →</button>
      </div>

      {/* scroll body */}
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-auto">
        <div className="flex">
          {/* time axis */}
          <div className="sticky left-0 z-20 shrink-0 bg-card">
            <div style={{ height: HEADER_HEIGHT }} />
            {Array.from({ length: HOURS }, (_, h) => (
              <div key={h} className="relative border-b border-line pr-2 text-right" style={{ height: HOUR_HEIGHT }}>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">{minutesToLabel(h * 60)}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* grid */}
          <div className="min-w-[840px] flex-1">
            {/* header row */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-7" style={{ height: HEADER_HEIGHT }}>
              {days.map((d) => {
                const key = dateKey(d);
                const isToday = todayKey !== null && key === todayKey;
                return (
                  <div key={key} className={...isToday highlight...}>
                    <div>...</div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* body */}
            <div className="relative" style={{ height: HOUR_HEIGHT * HOURS }}>
              {/* cells */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7">
                {Array.from({ length: HOURS * 7 }, (_, i) => {
                  const col = i % 7;
                  const hour = Math.floor(i / 7);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={i}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onSlotClick(dateKey(days[col]), hour * 60)}
                      className="border-b border-r border-line hover:bg-primary-soft/60"
                      style={{ height: HOUR_HEIGHT }}
                      aria-label={`${dateKey(days[col])} ${minutesToLabel(hour * 60)}`}
                    />
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* events overlay */}
              <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0">
                {events.map((ev) => {
                  const col = dateToIndex.get(ev.date);
                  if (col === undefined) return null;
                  const top = (ev.startMin / 60) * HOUR_HEIGHT;
                  const height = ((ev.endMin - ev.startMin) / 60) * HOUR_HEIGHT;
                  ...
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import WeekGrid from "./components/WeekGrid";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { addDays, dateKey, startOfWeek } from "@/lib/time";

export default function Home() {
  const [weekStart] = useState(() => startOfWeek(new Date()));

  const events: ScheduleEvent[] = [
    {
      id: "demo-course",
      title: "高等数学",
      date: dateKey(weekStart),
      startMin: 8 * 60,
      endMin: 9 * 60 + 30,
      kind: "course",
      location: "教一 201",
    },
    {
      id: "demo-task",
      title: "整理周报",
      date: dateKey(addDays(weekStart, 1)),
      startMin: 19 * 60,
      endMin: 20 * 60,
      kind: "task",
      unverified: true,
    },
  ];

  const handleSlotClick = useCallback((date: string, startMin: number) => {
    console.log("[slot]", date, startMin);
  }, []);

  const handleEventClick = useCallback((ev: ScheduleEvent) => {
    console.log("[event]", ev.title, ev);
  }, []);

  return (
    <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line bg-card px-4 py-3">
        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">周视图</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">课程 / 任务 / 事件</p>
      </header>
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1">
        <WeekGrid
          events={events}
          weekStart={weekStart}
          onSlotClick={handleSlotClick}
          onEventClick={handleEventClick}
        />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { addDays, dateKey, formatWeekRange, minutesToLabel } from "@/lib/time";

const HOUR_HEIGHT = 56;
const HOURS = 24;
const HEADER_HEIGHT = 56;
const COL_COUNT = 7;

const WEEKDAY_LABELS = ["周日", "周一", "周二", "周三", "周四", "周五", "周六"];

const KIND_STYLES: Record<ScheduleEvent["kind"], string> = {
  course: "bg-blue-600",
  task: "bg-emerald-600",
  event: "bg-slate-500",
};

type WeekGridProps = {
  events: ScheduleEvent[];
  weekStart: Date;
  onSlotClick: (date: string, startMin: number) => void;
  onEventClick: (ev: ScheduleEvent) => void;
  flashIds?: string[];
  conflictIds?: string[];
};

export default function WeekGrid({
  events,
  weekStart: initialWeekStart,
  onSlotClick,
  onEventClick,
  flashIds,
  conflictIds,
}: WeekGridProps) {
  const [weekStart, setWeekStart] = useState(initialWeekStart);
  const [todayKey, setTodayKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setTodayKey(dateKey(new Date()));
  }, []);

  const days = useMemo(
    () => Array.from({ length: COL_COUNT }, (_, i) => addDays(weekStart, i)),
    [weekStart],
  );

  const dateToIndex = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    days.forEach((d, i) => map.set(dateKey(d), i));
    return map;
  }, [days]);

  const flashSet = useMemo(() => new Set(flashIds ?? []), [flashIds]);
  const conflictSet = useMemo(() => new Set(conflictIds ?? []), [conflictIds]);

  const prevWeek = () => setWeekStart((w) => addDays(w, -7));
  const nextWeek = () => setWeekStart((w) => addDays(w, 7));

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col">
      {/* 顶部工具栏：上一周 / 下一周 / 当前周范围 */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-line bg-card px-4 py-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={prevWeek}
          className="inline-flex h-9 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-line bg-white px-3 text-sm text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50"
        >
          ← 上一周
        </button>
        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">
          {formatWeekRange(weekStart)}
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={nextWeek}
          className="inline-flex h-9 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-line bg-white px-3 text-sm text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50"
        >
          下一周 →
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 可滚动主体：横向 + 纵向 */}
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-auto">
        <div className="flex">
          {/* 左侧时间轴（横向滚动时固定） */}
          <div className="sticky left-0 z-20 shrink-0 border-r border-line bg-card">
            <div className="border-b border-line" style={{ height: HEADER_HEIGHT }} />
            {Array.from({ length: HOURS }, (_, h) => (
              <div
                key={h}
                className="border-b border-line pr-2 pt-0.5 text-right"
                style={{ height: HOUR_HEIGHT }}
              >
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  {minutesToLabel(h * 60)}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* 网格区域 */}
          <div className="min-w-[840px] flex-1">
            {/* 表头：周一到周日 */}
            <div
              className="grid grid-cols-7"
              style={{ height: HEADER_HEIGHT }}
            >
              {days.map((d) => {
                const key = dateKey(d);
                const isToday = todayKey !== null && todayKey === key;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={key}
                    className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center border-b border-r border-line ${
                      isToday ? "bg-primary-soft" : "bg-card"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`text-sm font-medium ${
                        isToday ? "text-primary" : "text-slate-700"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {WEEKDAY_LABELS[d.getDay()]}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`text-xs ${
                        isToday ? "text-primary" : "text-slate-400"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {key.slice(5).replace("-", "/")}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* 主体网格 + 事件浮层 */}
            <div className="relative" style={{ height: HOUR_HEIGHT * HOURS }}>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7">
                {Array.from({ length: HOURS * COL_COUNT }, (_, i) => {
                  const col = i % COL_COUNT;
                  const hour = Math.floor(i / COL_COUNT);
                  const key = dateKey(days[col]);
                  const isToday = todayKey !== null && todayKey === key;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={i}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onSlotClick(key, hour * 60)}
                      aria-label={`${key} ${minutesToLabel(hour * 60)}`}
                      className={`cursor-pointer border-b border-r border-line transition-colors hover:bg-primary-soft/70 ${
                        isToday ? "bg-primary-soft/60" : "bg-white"
                      }`}
                      style={{ height: HOUR_HEIGHT }}
                    />
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* 事件浮层 */}
              <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0">
                {events.map((ev) => {
                  const col = dateToIndex.get(ev.date);
                  if (col === undefined) return null;
                  const top = (ev.startMin / 60) * HOUR_HEIGHT;
                  const height = ((ev.endMin - ev.startMin) / 60) * HOUR_HEIGHT;
                  const left = (col * 100) / COL_COUNT;
                  const width = 100 / COL_COUNT;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={ev.id}
                      className="pointer-events-auto absolute p-0.5"
                      style={{
                        top,
                        height,
                        left: `${left}%`,
                        width: `${width}%`,
                      }}
                    >
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onEventClick(ev)}
                        className={`relative flex h-full w-full cursor-pointer flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-left text-xs text-white shadow-sm ${KIND_STYLES[ev.kind]} ${
                          conflictSet.has(ev.id) ? "ring-2 ring-red-500" : ""
                        } ${flashSet.has(ev.id) ? "animate-pulse" : ""}`}
                      >
                        {ev.unverified && (
                          <span className="absolute right-1 top-1 flex h-4 w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/90 text-[10px] font-bold leading-none text-slate-700">
                            ?
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span className="truncate pr-5 font-medium">
                          {ev.title}
                        </span>
                        <span className="truncate opacity-90">
                          {minutesToLabel(ev.startMin)} - {minutesToLabel(ev.endMin)}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  const now = useSyncExternalStore<number | null>(emptySubscribe, () => Date.now(), () => null);

  const handleSlotClick = useCallback(...);
  const handleEventClick = useCallback(...);

  // now 为 null 表示仍在服务端/首帧，此时不渲染网格，避免 prerender 期读取当前时间。

        <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center text-sm text-slate-400">
          加载中…
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const weekStart = startOfWeek(new Date(now));
  const events: ScheduleEvent[] = [
    { id: "demo-course", title: "高等数学", date: dateKey(weekStart), startMin: 8*60, endMin: 9*60+30, kind: "course", location: "教一 201" },
    { id: "demo-task", title: "整理周报", date: dateKey(addDays(weekStart, 1)), startMin: 19*60, endMin: 20*60, kind: "task", unverified: true },
  ];

  return (
    <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
      <header>...</header>
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1">
        <WeekGrid events={events} weekStart={weekStart} onSlotClick={handleSlotClick} onEventClick={handleEventClick} />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import WeekGrid from "./components/WeekGrid";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { addDays, dateKey, startOfWeek } from "@/lib/time";

const emptySubscribe = () => () => {};

export default function Home() {
  // 服务端/首帧为 false，挂载后为 true；用于避免在预渲染阶段读取当前时间。
  const isClient = useSyncExternalStore(
    emptySubscribe,
    () => true,
    () => false,
  );

  const handleSlotClick = useCallback((date: string, startMin: number) => {
    console.log("[slot]", date, startMin);
  }, []);

  const handleEventClick = useCallback((ev: ScheduleEvent) => {
    console.log("[event]", ev.title, ev);
  }, []);

  if (!isClient) {
    return (
      <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line bg-card px-4 py-3">
          <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">周视图</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">课程 / 任务 / 事件</p>
        </header>
        <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center text-sm text-slate-400">
          加载中…
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const weekStart = startOfWeek(new Date());
  const events: ScheduleEvent[] = [
    {
      id: "demo-course",
      title: "高等数学",
      date: dateKey(weekStart),
      startMin: 8 * 60,
      endMin: 9 * 60 + 30,
      kind: "course",
      location: "教一 201",
    },
    {
      id: "demo-task",
      title: "整理周报",
      date: dateKey(addDays(weekStart, 1)),
      startMin: 19 * 60,
      endMin: 20 * 60,
      kind: "task",
      unverified: true,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line bg-card px-4 py-3">
        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">周视图</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">课程 / 任务 / 事件</p>
      </header>
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1">
        <WeekGrid
          events={events}
          weekStart={weekStart}
          onSlotClick={handleSlotClick}
          onEventClick={handleEventClick}
        />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { minutesToLabel } from "@/lib/time";

const TIME_OPTIONS = Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => i * 30);

const KIND_OPTIONS: { value: ScheduleEvent["kind"]; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "course", label: "课程" },
  { value: "task", label: "任务" },
  { value: "event", label: "事件" },
];

const REMIND_OPTIONS: { value: number; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 0, label: "不提醒" },
  { value: 5, label: "提前 5 分钟" },
  { value: 10, label: "提前 10 分钟" },
  { value: 15, label: "提前 15 分钟" },
  { value: 30, label: "提前 30 分钟" },
];

type EventDialogProps = {
  mode: "new" | "edit";
  initial: ScheduleEvent;
  existing: ScheduleEvent[];
  onSave: (ev: ScheduleEvent) => void;
  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
};

export default function EventDialog({ mode, initial, existing, onSave, onDelete, onClose }: EventDialogProps) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(initial.title);
  const [startMin, setStartMin] = useState(initial.startMin);
  const [endMin, setEndMin] = useState(initial.endMin);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<ScheduleEvent["kind"]>(initial.kind);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(initial.location ?? "");
  const [remindBeforeMin, setRemindBeforeMin] = useState(initial.remindBeforeMin ?? 0);
  const [titleError, setTitleError] = useState("");
  const [timeError, setTimeError] = useState("");

  // 重叠检测：同一天、时间段相交（排除自身）
  const overlap = useMemo(() => {
    if (endMin <= startMin) return null;
    return (
      existing.find(
        (e) =>
          e.date === initial.date &&
          e.id !== initial.id &&
          e.startMin < endMin &&
          startMin < e.endMin,
      ) ?? null
    );
  }, [existing, initial.date, initial.id, startMin, endMin]);

  const handleSave = () => {
    const trimmed = title.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setTitleError("请输入标题");
      return;
    }
    if (endMin <= startMin) {
      setTimeError("结束时间必须晚于开始时间");
      return;
    }
    setTitleError("");
    setTimeError("");
    onSave({
      id: initial.id,
      title: trimmed,
      date: initial.date,
      startMin,
      endMin,
      kind,
      location: location.trim() || undefined,
      remindBeforeMin: remindBeforeMin > 0 ? remindBeforeMin : undefined,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4" onClick={onClose}>
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-line bg-white shadow-xl"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-5 py-4">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">
            {mode === "new" ? "新建事件" : "编辑事件"}
          </h2>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="关闭" className="...">✕</button>
        </header>

        <div className="space-y-4 px-5 py-4">
          {/* 标题 */}
          <Field label="标题">
            <input value={title} onChange={...} ... />
            {titleError && <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{titleError}</p>}
          </Field>

          {/* 时间 */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <Field label="开始时间">
              <select value={startMin} onChange={...}>
                {TIME_OPTIONS.map(m => <option key={m} value={m}>{minutesToLabel(m)}</option>)}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="结束时间">
              <select value={endMin} onChange={...}>...</select>
            </Field>
          </div>
          {timeError && <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{timeError}</p>}

          {/* 类型 */}
          <Field label="类型">
            <select value={kind} onChange={...}>{KIND_OPTIONS...}</select>
          </Field>

          {/* 地点 */}
          <Field label="地点（可选）">
            <input value={location} onChange={...} placeholder="选填" />
          </Field>

          {/* 提醒 */}
          <Field label="提前提醒">
            <select value={remindBeforeMin} onChange={...}>{REMIND_OPTIONS...}</select>
          </Field>

          {overlap && (
            <p className="rounded-md bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-amber-700">
              与「{overlap.title}」时间重叠
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <footer className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-line px-5 py-4">
          {mode === "edit" && onDelete ? (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => onDelete(initial.id)} className="text-red-600 ...">删除</button>
          ) : <span />}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="...">取消</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={handleSave} className="...">保存</button>
          </div>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import WeekGrid from "./components/WeekGrid";
import EventDialog from "./components/EventDialog";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { loadEvents, saveEvents } from "@/lib/storage";
import { addDays, dateKey, startOfWeek } from "@/lib/time";

const emptySubscribe = () => () => {};

function genId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
}

type DialogState =
  | { mode: "new"; event: ScheduleEvent }
  | { mode: "edit"; event: ScheduleEvent };

export default function Home() {
  const isClient = useSyncExternalStore(emptySubscribe, () => true, () => false);

  const [events, setEvents] = useState<ScheduleEvent[]>([]);
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<DialogState | null>(null);

  // 挂载后从 localStorage 读取已有事件（客户端才可访问 localStorage）。
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- 一次性初始化客户端状态，非派生数据同步
  useEffect(() => {
    setEvents(loadEvents());
  }, []);

  // 同一天、时间段相交的事件标记为冲突，网格上以红色左边框提示。
  const conflictIds = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < events.length; j++) {
        const a = events[i];
        const b = events[j];
        if (a.date === b.date && a.startMin < b.endMin && b.startMin < a.endMin) {
          set.add(a.id);
          set.add(b.id);
        }
      }
    }
    return Array.from(set);
  }, [events]);

  const handleSlotClick = useCallback((date: string, startMin: number) => {
    setDialog({
      mode: "new",
      event: {
        id: "",
        title: "",
        date,
        startMin,
        endMin: Math.min(startMin + 60, 1410),
        kind: "course",
      },
    });
  }, []);

  const handleEventClick = useCallback((ev: ScheduleEvent) => {
    setDialog({ mode: "edit", event: ev });
  }, []);

  const handleSave = useCallback((ev: ScheduleEvent) => {
    const withId = ev.id ? ev : { ...ev, id: genId() };
    setEvents((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.some((e) => e.id === withId.id);
      const next = exists
        ? prev.map((e) => (e.id === withId.id ? withId : e))
        : [...prev, withId];
      saveEvents(next);
      return next;
    });
    setDialog(null);
  }, []);

  const handleDelete = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setEvents((prev) => {
      const next = prev.filter((e) => e.id !== id);
      saveEvents(next);
      return next;
    });
    setDialog(null);
  }, []);

  const header = (
    <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line bg-card px-4 py-3">
      <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">周视图</h1>
      <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">课程 / 任务 / 事件</p>
    </header>
  );

  if (!isClient) {
    return (
      <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
        {header}
        <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center text-sm text-slate-400">
          加载中…
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const weekStart = startOfWeek(new Date());

  return (
    <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
      {header}
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1">
        <WeekGrid
          events={events}
          weekStart={weekStart}
          conflictIds={conflictIds}
          onSlotClick={handleSlotClick}
          onEventClick={handleEventClick}
        />
      </div>

      {dialog && (
        <EventDialog
          mode={dialog.mode}
          initial={dialog.event}
          existing={events}
          onSave={handleSave}
          onDelete={handleDelete}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

Wait, there's an issue with `handleSave` and `handleDelete` using `saveEvents(next)` INSIDE the `setEvents` updater. As I noted, this is a side effect inside the updater. In React StrictMode (dev), the updater may be called twice, causing `saveEvents(next)` to be called twice — but it's idempotent (writes same value). However, React 19's StrictMode double-invokes updaters, but the result of the second invocation is what's used. Writing localStorage twice is harmless.

But there's a subtler issue: React may call the updater with a "pending" state during concurrent rendering, and side effects in updaters are discouraged because they might not reflect the final committed state. For this simple app, it's fine, but let me be cleaner.

To avoid side effects in updater, I can compute `next` outside using the current `events` closure:

```tsx
const handleSave = useCallback((ev: ScheduleEvent) => {
  const withId = ev.id ? ev : { ...ev, id: genId() };
  const exists = events.some((e) => e.id === withId.id);
  const next = exists
    ? events.map((e) => (e.id === withId.id ? withId : e))
    : [...events, withId];
  setEvents(next);
  saveEvents(next);
  setDialog(null);
}, [events]);
```

This closes over `events`. The `useCallback` dep is `[events]`, so it re-creates when events change. This is clean (no side effects in updater). The only downside is the callback identity changes on each events change, but that's fine.


```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { minutesToLabel } from "@/lib/time";

const TIME_OPTIONS = Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => i * 30);

const KIND_OPTIONS: { value: ScheduleEvent["kind"]; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "course", label: "课程" },
  { value: "task", label: "任务" },
  { value: "event", label: "事件" },
];

const REMIND_OPTIONS: { value: number; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 0, label: "不提醒" },
  { value: 5, label: "提前 5 分钟" },
  { value: 10, label: "提前 10 分钟" },
  { value: 15, label: "提前 15 分钟" },
  { value: 30, label: "提前 30 分钟" },
];

const fieldLabel = "mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700";
const inputCls =
  "w-full rounded-md border border-line bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition-colors focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary";

type EventDialogProps = {
  mode: "new" | "edit";
  initial: ScheduleEvent;
  existing: ScheduleEvent[];
  onSave: (ev: ScheduleEvent) => void;
  onDelete: (id: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
};

export default function EventDialog({
  mode,
  initial,
  existing,
  onSave,
  onDelete,
  onClose,
}: EventDialogProps) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(initial.title);
  const [startMin, setStartMin] = useState(initial.startMin);
  const [endMin, setEndMin] = useState(initial.endMin);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<ScheduleEvent["kind"]>(initial.kind);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(initial.location ?? "");
  const [remindBeforeMin, setRemindBeforeMin] = useState(initial.remindBeforeMin ?? 0);
  const [titleError, setTitleError] = useState("");
  const [timeError, setTimeError] = useState("");

  const overlap = useMemo(() => {
    if (endMin <= startMin) return null;
    return (
      existing.find(
        (e) =>
          e.date === initial.date &&
          e.id !== initial.id &&
          e.startMin < endMin &&
          startMin < e.endMin,
      ) ?? null
    );
  }, [existing, initial.date, initial.id, startMin, endMin]);

  const handleSave = () => {
    const trimmed = title.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setTitleError("请输入标题");
      setTimeError("");
      return;
    }
    if (endMin <= startMin) {
      setTitleError("");
      setTimeError("结束时间必须晚于开始时间");
      return;
    }
    setTitleError("");
    setTimeError("");
    onSave({
      id: initial.id,
      title: trimmed,
      date: initial.date,
      startMin,
      endMin,
      kind,
      location: location.trim() || undefined,
      remindBeforeMin: remindBeforeMin > 0 ? remindBeforeMin : undefined,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-line bg-white shadow-xl"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-5 py-4">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">
            {mode === "new" ? "新建事件" : "编辑事件"}
          </h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="关闭"
            className="flex h-7 w-7 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-md text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600"
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </header>

        <div className="space-y-4 px-5 py-4">
          <div>
            <label className={fieldLabel}>标题</label>
            <input
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              className={inputCls}
              placeholder="例如：高等数学"
              autoFocus
            />
            {titleError && (
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600" role="alert">
                {titleError}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>开始时间</label>
              <select
                value={startMin}
                onChange={(e) => setStartMin(Number(e.target.value))}
                className={inputCls}
              >
                {TIME_OPTIONS.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m} value={m}>
                    {minutesToLabel(m)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>结束时间</label>
              <select
                value={endMin}
                onChange={(e) => setEndMin(Number(e.target.value))}
                className={inputCls}
              >
                {TIME_OPTIONS.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m} value={m}>
                    {minutesToLabel(m)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          {timeError && (
            <p className="text-xs text-red-600" role="alert">
              {timeError}
            </p>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className={fieldLabel}>类型</label>
            <select
              value={kind}
              onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value as ScheduleEvent["kind"])}
              className={inputCls}
            >
              {KIND_OPTIONS.map((k) => (
                <option key={k.value} value={k.value}>
                  {k.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className={fieldLabel}>地点（可选）</label>
            <input
              value={location}
              onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)}
              className={inputCls}
              placeholder="选填"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className={fieldLabel}>提前提醒</label>
            <select
              value={remindBeforeMin}
              onChange={(e) => setRemindBeforeMin(Number(e.target.value))}
              className={inputCls}
            >
              {REMIND_OPTIONS.map((r) => (
                <option key={r.value} value={r.value}>
                  {r.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {overlap && (
            <p className="rounded-md bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-amber-700">
              与「{overlap.title}」时间重叠
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <footer className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line px-5 py-4">
          <div>
            {mode === "edit" && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onDelete(initial.id)}
                className="h-9 cursor-pointer rounded-md px-3 text-sm font-medium text-red-600 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50"
              >
                删除
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="h-9 cursor-pointer rounded-md border border-line bg-white px-4 text-sm text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              取消
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSave}
              className="h-9 cursor-pointer rounded-md bg-primary px-4 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-blue-700"
            >
              保存
            </button>
          </div>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import WeekGrid from "./components/WeekGrid";
import EventDialog from "./components/EventDialog";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { loadEvents, saveEvents } from "@/lib/storage";
import { startOfWeek } from "@/lib/time";

const emptySubscribe = () => () => {};

function genId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
}

type DialogState = { mode: "new" | "edit"; event: ScheduleEvent };

export default function Home() {
  const isClient = useSyncExternalStore(emptySubscribe, () => true, () => false);

  const [events, setEvents] = useState<ScheduleEvent[]>([]);
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<DialogState | null>(null);

  // 挂载后从 localStorage 读取已有事件（仅在客户端访问 localStorage）。
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- 一次性初始化客户端状态，非派生数据同步
  useEffect(() => {
    setEvents(loadEvents());
  }, []);

  // 同一天、时间段相交的事件视为冲突，在网格上用红色左边框提示。
  const conflictIds = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < events.length; j++) {
        const a = events[i];
        const b = events[j];
        if (a.date === b.date && a.startMin < b.endMin && b.startMin < a.endMin) {
          set.add(a.id);
          set.add(b.id);
        }
      }
    }
    return Array.from(set);
  }, [events]);

  const handleSlotClick = (date: string, startMin: number) => {
    setDialog({
      mode: "new",
      event: {
        id: "",
        title: "",
        date,
        startMin,
        endMin: Math.min(startMin + 60, 1410),
        kind: "course",
      },
    });
  };

  const handleEventClick = (ev: ScheduleEvent) => {
    setDialog({ mode: "edit", event: ev });
  };

  const handleSave = (ev: ScheduleEvent) => {
    const withId = ev.id ? ev : { ...ev, id: genId() };
    const exists = events.some((e) => e.id === withId.id);
    const next = exists
      ? events.map((e) => (e.id === withId.id ? withId : e))
      : [...events, withId];
    setEvents(next);
    saveEvents(next);
    setDialog(null);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    const next = events.filter((e) => e.id !== id);
    setEvents(next);
    saveEvents(next);
    setDialog(null);
  };

  const header = (
    <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line bg-card px-4 py-3">
      <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">周视图</h1>
      <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">课程 / 任务 / 事件</p>
    </header>
  );

  if (!isClient) {
    return (
      <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
        {header}
        <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center text-sm text-slate-400">
          加载中…
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const weekStart = startOfWeek(new Date());

  return (
    <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
      {header}
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1">
        <WeekGrid
          events={events}
          weekStart={weekStart}
          conflictIds={conflictIds}
          onSlotClick={handleSlotClick}
          onEventClick={handleEventClick}
        />
      </div>

      {dialog && (
        <EventDialog
          mode={dialog.mode}
          initial={dialog.event}
          existing={events}
          onSave={handleSave}
          onDelete={handleDelete}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```ts
export function slotToRange(slot: number): { startMin: number; endMin: number } {
  const idx = Math.min(Math.max(slot - 1, 0), DEFAULT_PERIODS.length - 1);

}
```

```tsx
const handleFile = async (file: File) => {
  setPhase("uploading");
  setError("");
  try {
    const imageBase64 = await readAsBase64(file);
    const resp = await fetch("/api/recognize", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ imageBase64, mimeType: file.type }),
    });
    const json = await resp.json();
    if (!json.ok) {
      setError(json.error ?? "识别失败，请稍后重试");
      setPhase("idle");
      return;
    }
    const data = json.data;
    setRows(data.courses.map((c) => ({
      name: c.name,
      day: c.day,
      startSlot: c.startSlot,
      endSlot: c.endSlot,
      location: c.location,
    })));
    setDroppedCount(data.droppedCount ?? 0);
    setPhase("review");
  } catch (e) {
    setError("识别失败，请检查网络后重试");
    setPhase("idle");
  }
};
```

`readAsBase64`:
```tsx
function readAsBase64(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const result = reader.result;
      if (typeof result === "string") {
        // 去掉 data:...;base64, 前缀
        const comma = result.indexOf(",");
        resolve(comma >= 0 ? result.slice(comma + 1) : result);
      } else {
        reject(new Error("读取失败"));
      }
    };
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("读取失败"));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}
```

The API expects `imageBase64` (bare base64, no prefix). So I strip the `data:...;base64,` prefix. Good.

```tsx
    ? events.map((e) => (e.id === withId.id ? withId : e))
    : [...events, withId];
  ...
};
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import WeekGrid from "./components/WeekGrid";
import EventDialog from "./components/EventDialog";
import ImportTimetable from "./components/ImportTimetable";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { loadEvents, saveEvents } from "@/lib/storage";
import { startOfWeek } from "@/lib/time";

const emptySubscribe = () => () => {};

function genId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
}

type DialogState = { mode: "new" | "edit"; event: ScheduleEvent };

export default function Home() {
  const isClient = useSyncExternalStore(emptySubscribe, () => true, () => false);
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<ScheduleEvent[]>(() => loadEvents());
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<DialogState | null>(null);

  const conflictIds = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < events.length; j++) {
        const a = events[i];
        const b = events[j];
        if (a.date === b.date && a.startMin < b.endMin && b.startMin < a.endMin) {
          set.add(a.id);
          set.add(b.id);
        }
      }
    }
    return Array.from(set);
  }, [events]);

  const handleSlotClick = (date: string, startMin: number) => { ... same ... };
  const handleEventClick = (ev: ScheduleEvent) => { setDialog({ mode: "edit", event: ev }); };
  const handleSave = (ev: ScheduleEvent) => { ... same ... };
  const handleDelete = (id: string) => { ... same ... };
  const handleImport = (newEvents: ScheduleEvent[]) => {
    const next = [...events, ...newEvents];
    setEvents(next);
    saveEvents(next);
  };

  if (!isClient) {
    return (
      <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line bg-card px-4 py-3">
          <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">周视图</h1>
        </header>
        <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center text-sm text-slate-400">
          加载中…
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const weekStart = startOfWeek(new Date());

  return (
    <main className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line bg-card px-4 py-3">
        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">周视图</h1>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <ImportTimetable weekStart={weekStart} onImport={handleImport} />
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1">
        <WeekGrid
          events={events}
          weekStart={weekStart}
          conflictIds={conflictIds}
          onSlotClick={handleSlotClick}
          onEventClick={handleEventClick}
        />
      </div>

      {dialog && (
        <EventDialog
          mode={dialog.mode}
          initial={dialog.event}
          existing={events}
          onSave={handleSave}
          onDelete={handleDelete}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import { addDays, dateKey } from "@/lib/time";
import { slotToRange } from "@/lib/periods";

type ReviewCourse = {
  name: string;
  day: number;
  startSlot: number;
  endSlot: number;
  location: string;
};

type RecognizeResponse = {
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  data?: {
    courses: {
      name: string;
      day: number;
      startSlot: number;
      endSlot: number;
      location: string;
    }[];
    droppedCount: number;
  };
};

const DAY_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 1, label: "周一" },
  { value: 2, label: "周二" },
  { value: 3, label: "周三" },
  { value: 4, label: "周四" },
  { value: 5, label: "周五" },
  { value: 6, label: "周六" },
  { value: 7, label: "周日" },
];

const cellInput =
  "w-full rounded-md border border-line bg-white px-2 py-1 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition-colors focus:border-primary";

function genId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
}

function readAsBase64(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const result = reader.result;
      if (typeof result === "string") {
        const comma = result.indexOf(",");
        resolve(comma >= 0 ? result.slice(comma + 1) : result);
      } else {
        reject(new Error("读取图片失败"));
      }
    };
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("读取图片失败"));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

function clampSlot(n: number): number {
  const v = Math.round(Number(n));
  if (!Number.isFinite(v) || v < 1) return 1;
  if (v > 12) return 12;
  return v;
}

type ImportTimetableProps = {
  weekStart: Date;
  onImport: (events: ScheduleEvent[]) => void;
};

export default function ImportTimetable({ weekStart, onImport }: ImportTimetableProps) {
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"idle" | "uploading" | "review" | "error">("idle");
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<ReviewCourse[]>([]);
  const [droppedCount, setDroppedCount] = useState(0);

  const openPicker = () => fileRef.current?.click();

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = "";
    if (!file) return;
    void handleFile(file);
  };

  const handleFile = async (file: File) => {
    setStatus("uploading");
    setErrorMessage("");
    try {
      const imageBase64 = await readAsBase64(file);
      const resp = await fetch("/api/recognize", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ imageBase64, mimeType: file.type }),
      });
      const json = (await resp.json()) as RecognizeResponse;
      if (!json.ok || !json.data) {
        setErrorMessage(json.error ?? "识别失败，请稍后重试");
        setStatus("error");
        return;
      }
      setRows(
        json.data.courses.map((c) => ({
          name: c.name,
          day: c.day,
          startSlot: c.startSlot,
          endSlot: c.endSlot,
          location: c.location ?? "",
        })),
      );
      setDroppedCount(json.data.droppedCount ?? 0);
      setStatus("review");
    } catch {
      setErrorMessage("识别失败，请检查网络后重试");
      setStatus("error");
    }
  };

  const updateRow = (index: number, patch: Partial<ReviewCourse>) => {
    setRows((prev) => prev.map((r, i) => (i === index ? { ...r, ...patch } : r)));
  };

  const removeRow = (index: number) => {
    setRows((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    const events: ScheduleEvent[] = rows
      .filter((r) => r.name.trim())
      .map((r) => {
        const startSlot = clampSlot(r.startSlot);
        const endSlot = Math.max(startSlot, clampSlot(r.endSlot));
        const start = slotToRange(startSlot);
        const end = slotToRange(endSlot);
        return {
          id: genId(),
          title: r.name.trim(),
          date: dateKey(addDays(weekStart, r.day - 1)),
          startMin: start.startMin,
          endMin: end.endMin,
          kind: "course",
          location: r.location.trim() || undefined,
          unverified: true,
        };
      });
    onImport(events);
    setStatus("idle");
    setRows([]);
    setDroppedCount(0);
  };

  const close = () => {
    setStatus("idle");
    setRows([]);
    setDroppedCount(0);
    setErrorMessage("");
  };

  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={openPicker}
        className="inline-flex h-9 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-line bg-white px-3 text-sm text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50"
      >
        📷 拍照上传课表
      </button>
      <input
        ref={fileRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"
        capture="environment"
        className="hidden"
        onChange={handleFileChange}
      />

      {status !== "idle" && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4">
          <div className="w-full max-w-3xl rounded-xl border border-line bg-white shadow-xl">
            <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-5 py-4">
              <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">
                {status === "uploading" ? "识别课表" : status === "review" ? "校对课表" : "识别失败"}
              </h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={close} aria-label="关闭" className="...">×</button>
            </header>

            <div className="px-5 py-4">
              {status === "uploading" && (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-10">
                  <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-line border-t-primary" />
```

```ts
import { labelToMinutes } from "./time";

/** 默认作息：第 1~12 节对应的起止时间（HH:mm）。 */
export const DEFAULT_PERIODS: { slot: number; start: string; end: string }[] = [
  { slot: 1, start: "08:00", end: "08:45" },
  { slot: 2, start: "08:55", end: "09:40" },
  { slot: 3, start: "10:00", end: "10:45" },
  { slot: 4, start: "10:55", end: "11:40" },
  { slot: 5, start: "14:00", end: "14:45" },
  { slot: 6, start: "14:55", end: "15:40" },
  { slot: 7, start: "16:00", end: "16:45" },
  { slot: 8, start: "16:55", end: "17:40" },
  { slot: 9, start: "19:00", end: "19:45" },
  { slot: 10, start: "19:55", end: "20:40" },
  { slot: 11, start: "20:50", end: "21:35" },
  { slot: 12, start: "21:45", end: "22:30" },
];

/** 第 slot 节（从 1 开始）对应的起止分钟数；越界时收敛到最近的有效节次。 */
export function slotToRange(slot: number): { startMin: number; endMin: number } {
  const idx = Math.min(Math.max(Math.round(slot) - 1, 0), DEFAULT_PERIODS.length - 1);
  const p = DEFAULT_PERIODS[idx];
  return { startMin: labelToMinutes(p.start), endMin: labelToMinutes(p.end) };
}
```

Let me define the type in lib/conflicts.ts and export it.

lib/conflicts.ts:
```ts
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "./types";

export interface Conflict {
  aId: string;
  bId: string;
  reason: string;
}

export function findConflicts(events: ScheduleEvent[]): Conflict[] {
  const conflicts: Conflict[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < events.length; j++) {
      const a = events[i];
      const b = events[j];
      if (a.date !== b.date) continue;
      const overlap = a.startMin < b.endMin && b.startMin < a.endMin;
      if (!overlap) continue;
      const reason = a.kind === "course" || b.kind === "course"
        ? "与上课时间重叠"
        : "两个安排时间重叠";
      conflicts.push({ aId: a.id, bId: b.id, reason });
    }
  }
  return conflicts;
}
```

That's the pure function. Note: "同一天、时间区间有交集即冲突" — overlap condition `a.startMin < b.endMin && b.startMin < a.endMin`. Same as before. Note: adjacent events (endMin == startMin) are not conflict (no overlap). That's correct — intersection with zero duration isn't overlap. The previous code used `<` too, consistent.

Now the reason logic:
- "一方是 course → reason「与上课时间重叠」" — if either a or b is course.
- "都是 task/event → reason「两个安排时间重叠」" — both are task/event.

What about both are course? The requirement says "一方是 course → 与上课时间重叠". So if both course, still "与上课时间重叠" (at least one is course). And "都是 task/event → 两个安排时间重叠". So:
- if (a.kind === "course" || b.kind === "course") → "与上课时间重叠"
- else → "两个安排时间重叠"

That covers: course+task, course+event, course+course → "与上课时间重叠"; task+task, task+event, event+event → "两个安排时间重叠".

Let me design:

```ts
const MAX_EDGE = 1600;
const MAX_ORIGINAL_BYTES = 1.5 * 1024 * 1024;
const JPEG_QUALITY = 0.82;
const JPEG_MIME = "image/jpeg";

export interface CompressedImage {
  base64: string;
  mimeType: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

function blobToBase64(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const result = reader.result;
      if (typeof result === "string") {
        const comma = result.indexOf(",");
        resolve(comma >= 0 ? result.slice(comma + 1) : result);
      } else {
        reject(new Error("读取图片失败"));
      }
    };
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("读取图片失败"));
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

async function loadImageBitmap(file: File): Promise<{ width: number; height: number; bitmap: ImageBitmap | HTMLImageElement; cleanup: () => void }> {
  try {
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file);
    return { width: bitmap.width, height: bitmap.height, bitmap, cleanup: () => bitmap.close() };
  } catch {
    // fallback to new Image()
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    try {
      const img = await new Promise<HTMLImageElement>((resolve, reject) => {
        const el = new Image();
        el.onload = () => resolve(el);
        el.onerror = () => reject(new Error("读取图片失败"));
        el.src = url;
      });
      return { width: img.naturalWidth, height: img.naturalHeight, bitmap: img, cleanup: () => URL.revokeObjectURL(url) };
    } catch (e) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      throw e;
    }
  }
}

export async function compressImage(file: File): Promise<CompressedImage> {
  const { width, height, bitmap, cleanup } = await loadImageBitmap(file);
  try {
    const longEdge = Math.max(width, height);
    const smallEnough = longEdge <= MAX_EDGE && file.size <= MAX_ORIGINAL_BYTES;
    if (smallEnough) {
      // 复用原文件：直接读 base64，避免无谓重编码
      const base64 = await blobToBase64(file);
      return { base64, mimeType: file.type || JPEG_MIME, width, height };
    }
    // 需要缩放/重编码
    const scale = longEdge > MAX_EDGE ? MAX_EDGE / longEdge : 1;
    const outWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale));
    const outHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale));
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = outWidth;
    canvas.height = outHeight;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) throw new Error("读取图片失败");
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, outWidth, outHeight);
    const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
      canvas.toBlob((b) => (b ? resolve(b) : reject(new Error("压缩失败"))), JPEG_MIME, JPEG_QUALITY);
    });
    const base64 = await blobToBase64(blob);
    return { base64, mimeType: JPEG_MIME, width: outWidth, height: outHeight };
  } finally {
    cleanup();
  }
}
```

```ts
function eventStartTime(ev: ScheduleEvent): number {
  const [y, m, d] = ev.date.split("-").map(Number);
  const base = new Date(y, m - 1, d).getTime();
  return base + ev.startMin * 60000;
}
```

  - **稍后提醒**：`snoozeRef` Map 记录 `eventId → 下次允许时间`，点「10 分钟后再提」推后 10 分钟并放回待提醒。
  - **顶部开关**：「提醒 开/关」存 localStorage；「开启系统通知」按钮仅在 `Notification.permission === "default"` 时显示，点击主动 `requestPermission()`。

**设计要点**
- 扫描 effect 依赖 `[events, reminderEnabled]`，逻辑全部内联，避免 React Compiler 的 `set-state-in-effect` 规则（间隔回调里的 setState 是异步的，非同步触发）。
- 系统通知为可选加分：只读 `Notification.permission`，绝不自动弹权限请求。

验证结果：`npm run lint` 无 error，`npm run build` 通过。

问题（实测）：
输入「每周三晚上7点到9点复习高数」，模型返回
  date=2026-11-10（周一，且已过去）、startMin=1260（21:00）、endMin=1800（30:00）
正确答案应为 2026-11-11（周三）19:00-21:00。
且 endMin=1800 超出 1440 会被前端校验丢弃，用户看不到任何反馈。

根因：把日期算术交给了模型。改成模型只输出语义，程序算绝对时间。

要做：

1. app/api/plan/route.ts 的提示词改为要求返回：
{
  "actions": [
    { "op": "add",
      "event": {
        "day": number,          // 本周几：1=周一 … 7=周日
        "startHour": number,    // 0-23
        "startMinute": number,  // 0 或 30
        "durationMin": number,  // 持续分钟数，如 120
        "title": string,
        "kind": "course"|"task"|"event",
        "location": string,
        "remindBeforeMin": number
      }
    },
    { "op": "delete", "matchTitle": string, "day": number }
  ],
  "reply": string
}
提示中明确：不要说日期、不要说分钟数，只给「本周几 / 几点 / 多久」；
遇到「晚上7点」要换算成 startHour=19；遇到「到9点」要算 durationMin=120。

2. 在 app/api/plan/route.ts 里程序侧完成换算（服务端做，不只在前端做）：
   - 由 context.weekStart（周一 YYYY-MM-DD）加 (day-1) 天得到 date
   - startMin = startHour*60 + startMinute
   - endMin = startMin + durationMin
   - 校验：day 在 1..7、startHour 在 0..23、durationMin 在 15..720、endMin <= 1440
   - 不合法条目丢弃并计入 droppedCount
   - 返回 { ok:true, actions:[已换算成 {date,startMin,endMin,title,kind,location,remindBeforeMin}],
            reply, droppedCount }

3. app/page.tsx 的 executePlan 简化：因为服务端已换算并校验，
   前端只需按 op 执行，不要再做日期换算；保留 droppedCount 的展示。

4. 若 droppedCount > 0，在 reply 后追加「（已忽略 N 条无法识别的安排）」。

Since this is a date (no time), I can use `new Date(y, m-1, d + (day-1))` to get the correct date (Date handles month/year rollover). Then format back to "YYYY-MM-DD".

But wait, there's a timezone concern. The server runs in some timezone (Vercel uses UTC, local dev uses local). The `weekStart` string "YYYY-MM-DD" is a date without timezone. When I parse `new Date(y, m-1, d)`, it's interpreted in the server's local timezone. Adding days and formatting back with local getFullYear/getMonth/getDate gives the correct date as long as I stay consistent (no DST crossing issues for pure date arithmetic? Actually DST could shift by an hour but the date would still be correct if I add 24h and there's a DST transition... hmm).

Actually, for pure DATE arithmetic, the safest is to do it without timezone ambiguity. Since I just need to add an integer number of days to a "YYYY-MM-DD" string and get back "YYYY-MM-DD", I can:
- Parse y, m, d.
- Use `Date.UTC(y, m-1, d + (day-1))` and then format using UTC getters.

Using UTC avoids timezone/DST issues entirely. Let me write:

```ts
function addDaysToDateKey(dateKey: string, days: number): string {
  const [y, m, d] = dateKey.split("-").map(Number);
  const t = Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d + days);
  const dt = new Date(t);
  const yy = dt.getUTCFullYear();
  const mm = String(dt.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const dd = String(dt.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${yy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
}
```

This is clean and timezone-safe.

### Server validation & conversion function:

```ts
function convertActions(rawActions: unknown, weekStart: string): {
  actions: ConvertedAction[];
  droppedCount: number;
} {
  const actions = Array.isArray(rawActions) ? rawActions : [];
  const result: ConvertedAction[] = [];
  let droppedCount = 0;

  for (const raw of actions) {
    const a = (raw ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const op = a.op;
    if (op !== "add" && op !== "delete") {
      droppedCount++;
      continue;
    }
    if (op === "delete") {
      const matchTitle = typeof a.matchTitle === "string" ? a.matchTitle.trim() : "";
      const day = toInt(a.day);
      if (!matchTitle || day < 1 || day > 7) {
        droppedCount++;
        continue;
      }
      const date = addDaysToDateKey(weekStart, day - 1);
      result.push({ op: "delete", date, matchTitle });
      continue;
    }
    // add
    const ev = (a.event ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const title = typeof ev.title === "string" ? ev.title.trim() : "";
    const day = toInt(ev.day);
    const startHour = toInt(ev.startHour);
    const startMinute = toInt(ev.startMinute);
    const durationMin = toInt(ev.durationMin);
    if (!title) { droppedCount++; continue; }
    if (day < 1 || day > 7) { droppedCount++; continue; }
    if (startHour < 0 || startHour > 23) { droppedCount++; continue; }
    if (startMinute < 0 || startMinute > 59) { droppedCount++; continue; }  // requirement says 0 or 30, but validate range
    if (durationMin < 15 || durationMin > 720) { droppedCount++; continue; }
    const startMin = startHour * 60 + startMinute;
    const endMin = startMin + durationMin;
    if (endMin > 1440) { droppedCount++; continue; }
    const date = addDaysToDateKey(weekStart, day - 1);
    const kindRaw = typeof ev.kind === "string" ? ev.kind : "";
    const kind = kindRaw === "course" || kindRaw === "task" || kindRaw === "event" ? kindRaw : "event";
    const location = typeof ev.location === "string" ? ev.location.trim() : "";
    const remindBeforeMin = typeof ev.remindBeforeMin === "number" ? ev.remindBeforeMin : undefined;
    result.push({
      op: "add",
      date, startMin, endMin, title, kind, location,
      remindBeforeMin: remindBeforeMin && remindBeforeMin > 0 ? remindBeforeMin : undefined,
    });
  }

  return { actions: result, droppedCount };
}
```

New executePlan (client):
```ts
type ConvertedPlanAction =
  | { op: "add"; date: string; startMin: number; endMin: number; title: string; kind: ScheduleEvent["kind"]; location?: string; remindBeforeMin?: number }
  | { op: "delete"; date: string; matchTitle: string };

function executePlan(
  rawActions: unknown,
  events: ScheduleEvent[],
): { next: ScheduleEvent[]; added: ScheduleEvent[]; dropped: number } {
  const actions = Array.isArray(rawActions) ? rawActions : [];
  const added: ScheduleEvent[] = [];
  const deleteKeys = new Set<string>();

  for (const raw of actions) {
    const a = (raw ?? {}) as { op?: unknown; date?: unknown; startMin?: unknown; endMin?: unknown; title?: unknown; kind?: unknown; location?: unknown; remindBeforeMin?: unknown; matchTitle?: unknown };
    if (a.op === "delete") {
      const matchTitle = typeof a.matchTitle === "string" ? a.matchTitle.trim() : "";
      const date = typeof a.date === "string" ? a.date : "";
      if (matchTitle && date) deleteKeys.add(`${date}\u0000${matchTitle}`);
      continue;
    }
    if (a.op !== "add") continue;
    const title = typeof a.title === "string" ? a.title.trim() : "";
    const date = typeof a.date === "string" ? a.date : "";
    const startMin = Math.round(Number(a.startMin));
    const endMin = Math.round(Number(a.endMin));
    if (!title || !date) continue;
    const kindRaw = typeof a.kind === "string" ? a.kind : "";
    const kind: ScheduleEvent["kind"] = kindRaw === "course" || kindRaw === "task" || kindRaw === "event" ? kindRaw : "event";
    added.push({
      id: genId(),
      title,
      date,
      startMin,
      endMin,
      kind,
      location: typeof a.location === "string" ? a.location.trim() : undefined,
      remindBeforeMin: typeof a.remindBeforeMin === "number" && a.remindBeforeMin > 0 ? a.remindBeforeMin : undefined,
    });
  }

  const next = events.filter((e) => !deleteKeys.has(`${e.date}\u0000${e.title}`)).concat(added);
  return { next, added, dropped: 0 };
}
```

### lib/freeSlots.ts

```ts
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "./types";

export interface FreeSlot {
  date: string;
  startMin: number;
  endMin: number;
}

export function computeFreeSlots(
  events: ScheduleEvent[],
  startDate: string,
  days: number,
  dayStartMin = 480,
  dayEndMin = 1380,
  minSlotMin = 30,
): FreeSlot[] {
  const result: FreeSlot[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
    const date = addDays(startDate, i);
    // 收集当天与 [dayStart, dayEnd] 有交集的占用，裁剪到边界
    const occupied: Array<{ startMin: number; endMin: number }> = [];
    for (const ev of events) {
      if (ev.date !== date) continue;
      const s = Math.max(ev.startMin, dayStartMin);
      const e = Math.min(ev.endMin, dayEndMin);
      if (e > s) occupied.push({ startMin: s, endMin: e });
    }
    // 按开始时间排序
    occupied.sort((a, b) => a.startMin - b.startMin);
    // 从 dayStartMin 开始，逐块减去占用
    let cursor = dayStartMin;
    for (const occ of occupied) {
      if (occ.startMin > cursor) {
        pushSlot(cursor, occ.startMin);
      }
      if (occ.endMin > cursor) cursor = occ.endMin;
    }
    if (dayEndMin > cursor) {
      pushSlot(cursor, dayEndMin);
    }

    function pushSlot(s: number, e: number) {
      if (e - s >= minSlotMin) result.push({ date, startMin: s, endMin: e });
    }
  }
  return result;
}
```

props: { value: number; onChange: (min: number) => void; minAllowed?: number; maxAllowed?: number }
- 两列轮盘：小时列（0-23）、分钟列（00,05,...,55 共 12 项）
- 实现方式（不引库）：
  · 每列是一个 overflow-y-auto 容器，高 160px，单项高 32px
  · 容器设 scroll-snap-type: y mandatory; overscroll-behavior: contain;
  · 每项 scroll-snap-align: center
  · 上下各放 64px 的空占位，保证首尾项也能滚到中间
  · 容器中间叠一个 32px 高的高亮框（绝对定位，border 或 bg-accent-soft）
  · 容器上下用渐隐遮罩（linear-gradient 白色/透明，深色主题用 var(--surface)）
  · 滚动停止 120ms 后用 scrollTop 计算居中项：index = Math.round(scrollTop / 32)
  · 值变化时通过 onChange 回调抛出（小时*60 + 分钟）
- 挂载与 value 外部变化时，要把两列 scrollTop 设到对应项（32 * index），不要用 smooth

```tsx
export default function TimeWheel({ value, onChange, minAllowed, maxAllowed }) {
  const hour = Math.floor(value / 60) % 24;
  const minute = value % 60;
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const hourRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const minuteRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // scroll to current on mount/value change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hourRef.current) hourRef.current.scrollTop = hour * ITEM_H;
    if (minuteRef.current) minuteRef.current.scrollTop = (minute / 5) * ITEM_H;
  }, [hour, minute]);

  const settle = (which: "hour" | "minute") => {
    if (timerRef.current) window.clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    timerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

const ITEM_H = 32;
const VIEW_H = 160; // 容器高度
const SPACER_H = 64;
const HOURS = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => i);
const MINUTES = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => i * 5);

function pad2(n: number): string {
  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
}

function toHHMM(min: number): string {
  return `${pad2(Math.floor(min / 60))}:${pad2(min % 60)}`;
}

function parseHHMM(s: string): number | null {
  const [h, m] = s.split(":").map(Number);
  if (!Number.isFinite(h) || !Number.isFinite(m)) return null;
  return h * 60 + m;
}

type TimeWheelProps = {
  value: number;
  onChange: (min: number) => void;
  minAllowed?: number;
  maxAllowed?: number;
};

export default function TimeWheel({ value, onChange, minAllowed, maxAllowed }: TimeWheelProps) {
  const hour = Math.floor(value / 60);
  const minute = value % 60;
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const hourRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const minuteRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const settleTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // 挂载与外部 value 变化时，把两列滚到对应项（不用 smooth）。
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hourRef.current) hourRef.current.scrollTop = hour * ITEM_H;
    if (minuteRef.current) minuteRef.current.scrollTop = (minute / 5) * ITEM_H;
  }, [hour, minute]);

  const clamp = (m: number) => {
    let v = m;
    if (minAllowed != null && v < minAllowed) v = minAllowed;
    if (maxAllowed != null && v > maxAllowed) v = maxAllowed;
    return v;
  };

  const settle = (which: "hour" | "minute") => {
    if (settleTimer.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(settleTimer.current);
    settleTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      settleTimer.current = null;
      if (which === "hour") {
        const el = hourRef.current;
        if (!el) return;
        const idx = Math.round(el.scrollTop / ITEM_H);
        const h = Math.min(23, Math.max(0, idx));
        onChange(clamp(h * 60 + minute));
      } else {
        const el = minuteRef.current;
        if (!el) return;
        const idx = Math.round(el.scrollTop / ITEM_H);
        const m = Math.min(11, Math.max(0, idx)) * 5;
        onChange(clamp(hour * 60 + m));
      }
    }, 120);
  };

  ...
}
```

Let me write the final TimeWheel.tsx:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

const ITEM_H = 32;
const SPACER_H = 64;
const HOURS = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => i);
const MINUTES = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => i * 5);

function pad2(n: number): string {
  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
}

function toHHMM(min: number): string {
  return `${pad2(Math.floor(min / 60))}:${pad2(min % 60)}`;
}

function parseHHMM(s: string): number | null {
  const parts = s.split(":");
  if (parts.length !== 2) return null;
  const h = Number(parts[0]);
  const m = Number(parts[1]);
  if (!Number.isFinite(h) || !Number.isFinite(m)) return null;
  return h * 60 + m;
}

type TimeWheelProps = {
  value: number;
  onChange: (min: number) => void;
  minAllowed?: number;
  maxAllowed?: number;
};

export default function TimeWheel({ value, onChange, minAllowed, maxAllowed }: TimeWheelProps) {
  const hour = Math.floor(value / 60);
  const minute = value % 60;
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const hourRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const minuteRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const settleTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hourRef.current) hourRef.current.scrollTop = hour * ITEM_H;
    if (minuteRef.current) minuteRef.current.scrollTop = (minute / 5) * ITEM_H;
  }, [hour, minute]);

  const clamp = (m: number) => {
    let v = Math.round(m / 5) * 5;
    if (minAllowed != null && v < minAllowed) v = minAllowed;
    if (maxAllowed != null && v > maxAllowed) v = maxAllowed;
    return v;
  };

  const settle = (which: "hour" | "minute") => {
    if (settleTimer.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(settleTimer.current);
    settleTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      settleTimer.current = null;
      if (which === "hour") {
        const el = hourRef.current;
        if (!el) return;
        const idx = Math.round(el.scrollTop / ITEM_H);
        const h = Math.min(23, Math.max(0, idx));
        onChange(clamp(h * 60 + minute));
      } else {
        const el = minuteRef.current;
        if (!el) return;
        const idx = Math.round(el.scrollTop / ITEM_H);
        const m = Math.min(11, Math.max(0, idx)) * 5;
        onChange(clamp(hour * 60 + m));
      }
    }, 120);
  };

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-[160px] items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50">
        <input
          type="time"
          step={300}
          value={toHHMM(value)}
          onChange={(e) => {
            const m = parseHHMM(e.target.value);
            if (m !== null) onChange(clamp(m));
          }}
          onBlur={() => setEditing(false)}
          autoFocus
          className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-center text-xl font-semibold text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-100"
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const renderColumn = (
    which: "hour" | "minute",
    items: number[],
    label: string,
    format: (n: number) => string,
    isDisabled: (n: number) => boolean,
    display: number,
  ) => {
    const ref = which === "hour" ? hourRef : minuteRef;
    return (
      <div className="relative h-[160px]">
        <div
          ref={ref}
          onScroll={() => settle(which)}
          role="listbox"
          aria-label={label}
          className="no-scrollbar h-full overflow-y-auto"
          style={{ scrollSnapType: "y mandatory", overscrollBehavior: "contain" }}
        >
          <div style={{ height: SPACER_H }} />
          {items.map((n) => {
            const disabled = isDisabled(n);
            return (
              <div
                key={n}
                role="option"
                aria-selected={n === display}
                className={`flex h-8 items-center justify-center text-sm font-medium ${
                  disabled ? "pointer-events-none text-slate-300" : "text-slate-900"
                }`}
                style={{ scrollSnapAlign: "center" }}
              >
                {format(n)}
              </div>
            );
          })}
          <div style={{ height: SPACER_H }} />
        </div>

        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-16 flex h-8 items-center justify-center border-y border-indigo-200 bg-primary-soft">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setEditing(true)}
            className="pointer-events-auto cursor-pointer rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-700 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-100"
          >
            {format(display)}
          </button>
        </div>

        <div
          className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-8"
          style={{ background: "linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--color-card), transparent)" }}
        />
        <div
          className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-8"
          style={{ background: "linear-gradient(to top, var(--color-card), transparent)" }}
        />
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
      {renderColumn(
        "hour",
        HOURS,
        "小时",
        (n) => String(n),
        (h) =>
          (minAllowed != null && h * 60 + 55 < minAllowed) ||
          (maxAllowed != null && h * 60 > maxAllowed),
        hour,
      )}
      {renderColumn(
        "minute",
        MINUTES,
        "分钟",
        (n) => pad2(n),
        (m) =>
```

```ts
function formatDurationTotal(min: number): string {
  if (min <= 0) return "共 0 分钟";
  const h = Math.floor(min / 60);
  const m = min % 60;
  if (h === 0) return `共 ${m} 分钟`;
  if (m === 0) return `共 ${h} 小时`;
  return `共 ${h} 小时 ${m} 分`;
}
```

So rules:

- If no ":", it's a number string. 
  - length 1-2: hour only (0-23). e.g., "19" → 19:00, "9" → 9:00.
  - length 3: HMM → hour = first digit, minute = last 2 digits. e.g., "930" → 9:30.

  - length > 4 → null (or invalid).
- Validate hour 0-23, minute 0-59.

Let me write parseTime.ts:

```ts
export function parseTime(input: string): number | null {
  const s = input.trim();
  if (!s) return null;

  let hourStr: string;
  let minuteStr: string;

  if (s.includes(":")) {
    const parts = s.split(":");
    if (parts.length !== 2) return null;
    hourStr = parts[0];
    minuteStr = parts[1];
  } else if (/^\d+$/.test(s)) {
    if (s.length <= 2) {
      hourStr = s;
      minuteStr = "0";
    } else if (s.length === 3) {
      hourStr = s[0];
      minuteStr = s.slice(1);
    } else if (s.length === 4) {
      hourStr = s.slice(0, 2);
      minuteStr = s.slice(2);
    } else {
      return null;
    }
  } else {
    return null;
  }

  if (hourStr === "" || minuteStr === "") return null;
  const hour = Number(hourStr);
  const minute = Number(minuteStr);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || !Number.isFinite(minute)) return null;
  if (hour < 0 || hour > 23 || minute < 0 || minute > 59) return null;
  return hour * 60 + minute;
}
```
