Plan for new TimeWheel:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { parseTime } from "@/lib/parseTime";

const ITEM_H = 32;
const SPACER_H = 64;
const HOURS = Array.from({length:24},(_,i)=>i);
const MINUTES = Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>i*5);

function pad2(n){...}
function toHHMM(min){...}

type TimeWheelProps = {
  value: number;
  onChange: (min: number) => void;
  minAllowed?: number;
  maxAllowed?: number;
  validateInput?: (min: number) => string | null;
};

export default function TimeWheel({ value, onChange, minAllowed, maxAllowed, validateInput }) {
  const hour = Math.floor(value / 60);
  const minute = value % 60;
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [inputError, setInputError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hourRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);   // scroll container
  const minuteRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const hourWrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); // wrapper for wheel/click
  const minuteWrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const settleTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastWheel = useRef<{ hour: number; minute: number }>({ hour: 0, minute: 0 });

  const normalize = (m: number) => Math.round(m / 5) * 5;

  // scroll to value on mount/external change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hourRef.current) hourRef.current.scrollTop = hour * ITEM_H;
    if (minuteRef.current) minuteRef.current.scrollTop = (minute / 5) * ITEM_H;
  }, [hour, minute]);

  const settle = (which) => {
    if (settleTimer.current !== null) clearTimeout(settleTimer.current);
    settleTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      settleTimer.current = null;
      if (which === "hour") {
        const el = hourRef.current; if (!el) return;
        const idx = Math.round(el.scrollTop / ITEM_H);
        const h = Math.min(23, Math.max(0, idx));
        onChange(normalize(h * 60 + minute));
      } else {
        const el = minuteRef.current; if (!el) return;
        const idx = Math.round(el.scrollTop / ITEM_H);
        const m = Math.min(11, Math.max(0, idx)) * 5;
        onChange(normalize(hour * 60 + m));
      }
    }, 120);
  };

  // wheel binding: decelerate
  useEffect(() => {
    const bind = (wrap: HTMLDivElement | null, scroller: HTMLDivElement | null, which: "hour" | "minute") => {
      if (!wrap || !scroller) return () => {};
      const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastWheel.current[which] < 60) return;
        lastWheel.current[which] = now;
        const direction = e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        scroller.scrollBy({ top: direction * ITEM_H, behavior: "smooth" });
      };
      wrap.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { passive: false });
      return () => wrap.removeEventListener("wheel", onWheel);
    };
    const u1 = bind(hourWrapRef.current, hourRef.current, "hour");
    const u2 = bind(minuteWrapRef.current, minuteRef.current, "minute");
    return () => { u1(); u2(); };
  }, []);
```

```tsx
};
```

Let me finalize parseTime:

```ts
export function parseTime(input: string): number | null {
  const s = input.trim().replace(/：/g, ":");
  if (!s) return null;

  let hourStr: string;
  let minuteStr: string;

  if (s.includes(":")) {
    const parts = s.split(":");
    if (parts.length !== 2) return null;
    hourStr = parts[0];
    minuteStr = parts[1];
  } else if (/^\d+$/.test(s)) {
    if (s.length === 1 || s.length === 2) {
      hourStr = s;
      minuteStr = "0";
    } else if (s.length === 3) {
      hourStr = s.slice(0, 1);
      minuteStr = s.slice(1);
    } else if (s.length === 4) {
      hourStr = s.slice(0, 2);
      minuteStr = s.slice(2);
    } else {
      return null;
    }
  } else {
    return null;
  }

  if (!hourStr || !minuteStr) return null;
  const hour = Number(hourStr);
  const minute = Number(minuteStr);
  if (!Number.isInteger(hour) || !Number.isInteger(minute)) return null;
  if (hour < 0 || hour > 23 || minute < 0 || minute > 59) return null;
  return hour * 60 + minute;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { parseTime } from "@/lib/parseTime";

const ITEM_H = 32;
const SPACER_H = 64;
const HOURS = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => i);
const MINUTES = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => i * 5);

function pad2(n: number): string {
  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
}

function toHHMM(min: number): string {
  return `${pad2(Math.floor(min / 60))}:${pad2(min % 60)}`;
}

type TimeWheelProps = {
  value: number;
  onChange: (min: number) => void;
  minAllowed?: number;
  maxAllowed?: number;
  validateInput?: (min: number) => string | null;
};

export default function TimeWheel({ value, onChange, minAllowed, maxAllowed, validateInput }: TimeWheelProps) {
  const hour = Math.floor(value / 60);
  const minute = value % 60;
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [inputError, setInputError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hourRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const minuteRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const hourWrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const minuteWrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const settleTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastWheel = useRef<{ hour: number; minute: number }>({ hour: 0, minute: 0 });

  const normalize = (m: number) => Math.round(m / 5) * 5;

  // 挂载与外部 value 变化时滚到对应项（不用 smooth）。
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hourRef.current) hourRef.current.scrollTop = hour * ITEM_H;
    if (minuteRef.current) minuteRef.current.scrollTop = (minute / 5) * ITEM_H;
  }, [hour, minute]);

  // 编辑态自动聚焦并全选。
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing && inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.focus();
      inputRef.current.select();
    }
  }, [editing]);

  // 滚动停止 120ms 后按 scrollTop 计算居中项。
  const settle = (which: "hour" | "minute") => {
    if (settleTimer.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(settleTimer.current);
    settleTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      settleTimer.current = null;
      if (which === "hour") {
        const el = hourRef.current;
        if (!el) return;
        const idx = Math.round(el.scrollTop / ITEM_H);
        const h = Math.min(23, Math.max(0, idx));
        onChange(normalize(h * 60 + minute));
      } else {
        const el = minuteRef.current;
        if (!el) return;
        const idx = Math.round(el.scrollTop / ITEM_H);
        const m = Math.min(11, Math.max(0, idx)) * 5;
        onChange(normalize(hour * 60 + m));
      }
    }, 120);
  };

  const step = (which: "hour" | "minute", dir: number) => {
    if (which === "hour") {
      const h = Math.min(23, Math.max(0, hour + dir));
      onChange(normalize(h * 60 + minute));
    } else {
      const m = Math.min(11, Math.max(0, Math.round(minute / 5) + dir)) * 5;
      onChange(normalize(hour * 60 + m));
    }
  };

  // wheel 减速：手动绑定，passive:false 才能 preventDefault。
  useEffect(() => {
    const bind = (
      wrap: HTMLDivElement | null,
      scroller: HTMLDivElement | null,
      which: "hour" | "minute",
    ) => {
      if (!wrap || !scroller) return () => {};
      const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastWheel.current[which] < 60) return;
        lastWheel.current[which] = now;
        const dir = e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        scroller.scrollBy({ top: dir * ITEM_H, behavior: "smooth" });
      };
      wrap.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { passive: false });
      return () => wrap.removeEventListener("wheel", onWheel);
    };
    const u1 = bind(hourWrapRef.current, hourRef.current, "hour");
    const u2 = bind(minuteWrapRef.current, minuteRef.current, "minute");
    return () => {
      u1();
      u2();
    };
  }, []);

  const startEdit = () => {
    setDraft(toHHMM(value));
    setInputError(null);
    setEditing(true);
  };

  const commit = () => {
    const m = parseTime(draft);
    if (m === null) {
      setInputError("时间格式不正确，如 19:30 或 1930");
      return;
    }
    const normalized = normalize(m);
    const err = validateInput ? validateInput(normalized) : null;
    if (err) {
      setInputError(err);
      return;
    }
    onChange(normalized);
    setEditing(false);
  };

  const cancelEdit = () => {
    setEditing(false);
    setInputError(null);
  };

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-[160px] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3">
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          value={draft}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setDraft(e.target.value);
            setInputError(null);
          }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
              e.preventDefault();
              commit();
            } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              cancelEdit();
            }
          }}
          onBlur={commit}
          className={`w-full max-w-[160px] rounded-lg border bg-white px-3 py-2 text-center text-xl font-semibold outline-none transition-colors focus:ring-2 ${
            inputError
              ? "border-red-400 text-red-600 focus:border-red-400 focus:ring-red-100"
              : "border-slate-200 text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-400 focus:ring-indigo-100"
          }`}
        />
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">直接输入，如 19:30 或 1930，回车确认</p>
        {inputError && (
          <p className="text-xs text-red-600" role="alert">{inputError}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const renderColumn = (
    which: "hour" | "minute",
    items: number[],
    label: string,
    format: (n: number) => string,
    isDisabled: (n: number) => boolean,
    display: number,
  ) => {
    const wrapRef = which === "hour" ? hourWrapRef : minuteWrapRef;
    const scrollerRef = which === "hour" ? hourRef : minuteRef;
    return (
      <div ref={wrapRef} onDoubleClick={startEdit} className="relative h-[160px]">
        <div
          ref={scrollerRef}
          onScroll={() => settle(which)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
              e.preventDefault();
              step(which, -1);
            } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
              e.preventDefault();
              step(which, 1);
            }
          }}
          tabIndex={0}
          role="listbox"
          aria-label={label}
          className="no-scrollbar h-full overflow-y-auto outline-none"
          style={{ scrollSnapType: "y mandatory", overscrollBehavior: "contain" }}
        >
          <div style={{ height: SPACER_H }} />
          {items.map((n) => {
            const disabled = isDisabled(n);
            return (
              <div
                key={n}
                role="option"
                aria-selected={n === display}
                className={`flex h-8 items-center justify-center text-sm font-medium ${
                  disabled ? "pointer-events-none text-slate-300" : "text-slate-900"
                }`}
                style={{ scrollSnapAlign: "center" }}
              >
                {format(n)}
              </div>
            );
          })}
          <div style={{ height: SPACER_H }} />
        </div>

        {/* 中间高亮框 */}
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-16 flex h-8 items-center justify-center border-y border-indigo-200 bg-primary-soft">
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-700">{format(display)}</span>
        </div>

        {/* 点击上下渐隐区步进 */}
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={`${label}减一项`}
          onClick={() => step(which, -1)}
          className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-8 cursor-pointer"
          style={{ background: "linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--color-card), transparent)" }}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={`${label}加一项`}
          onClick={() => step(which, 1)}
          className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-8 cursor-pointer"
          style={{ background: "linear-gradient(to top, var(--color-card), transparent)" }}
        />
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
      {renderColumn("hour", HOURS, "小时", (n) => String(n), (h) => ..., hour)}
      {renderColumn("minute", MINUTES, "分钟", (n) => pad2(n), (m) => ..., minute)}
    </div>
  );
}
```

用真实课表截图测试，模型返回的 periods 10/10 全对、课程名 10/10 全对，

当成一列从上往下读，完全没有理解「列 = 星期」。

【一】新契约
提示词改为要求输出网格，不再要求模型给出 day/startSlot/endSlot：

{
  "slotsPerDay": number,
  "periods": [{ "slot": number, "start": string, "end": string }],
  "columns": [{ "index": number, "label": string }],
  "rows": [{ "slot": number, "cells": string[] }]
}

规则（写进提示词）：
- columns 按图片从左到右列出表头文字（如 一/二/三 或 星期一…星期日），
  index 从 1 开始，对应星期几（1=周一 … 7=周日）。表头有日期数字时要忽略数字。
- rows 按图片从上到下，slot 用左侧节次编号（1,2,3…）；
  左侧若同时印时间，一并填进 periods。
- cells 的长度必须等于 columns 的长度，一一对应；
  一格放该格子里的全部文字（课程名、地点、周次都保留原文，用空格分隔）。
- 空格子用空字符串 ""。
- 不要做任何"这门课属于星期几"的判断——那是程序的事。
- 只输出这一个 JSON，不要解释文字。

【二】程序侧（新增 lib/gridToCourses.ts 纯函数）
export function gridToCourses(data): { courses: Course[]; droppedCount: number }
1. 按 columns 的 index 建立「列下标 → 星期」映射
2. 遍历每行每列，跳过空 cell
3. 纵向合并：同一列相邻行的 cell 文字完全相同（去掉首尾空格后）→ 视为同一门课，
   startSlot 取第一条的 slot、endSlot 取最后一条的 slot
4. 纵向合并后，把 cell 文字拆成 name / location：
   - 若含 "@"，以最后一个 "@" 之后的部分作为 location，之前作为 name
   - 否则：若末尾出现「楼+数字」「室+数字」「馆」等模式，作为 location，其余为 name

5. 每个课程块产出一条 Course { name, day, startSlot, endSlot, weeks, location, teacher:"" }
6. 校验：day 必须在 1..7、slot 在 1..slotsPerDay、endSlot >= startSlot，
   不合法丢弃并计数

Now the `gridToCourses` function:

```ts
export function gridToCourses(data: unknown): { courses: Course[]; droppedCount: number } {
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object") {
    return { courses: [], droppedCount: 0 };
  }
  const d = data as Record<string, unknown>;
  const slotsPerDay = clampInt(d.slotsPerDay, 1, 30, 12);
  const columnsRaw = Array.isArray(d.columns) ? d.columns : [];
  const columns = columnsRaw.map(...) // { index, label }
  const rowsRaw = Array.isArray(d.rows) ? d.rows : [];

  // colIdx -> day
  const dayByCol = columns.map((c) => c.index);

  // iterate
  let droppedCount = 0;
  const courses: Course[] = [];

  // For each column, scan rows top to bottom, merge consecutive identical cells.
  for (let c = 0; c < columns.length; c++) {
    const day = dayByCol[c];
    let i = 0;
    while (i < rows.length) {
      const row = rows[i];
      const cell = (row.cells[c] ?? "").trim();
      if (!cell) { i++; continue; }
      // find consecutive identical
      let j = i;
      while (j + 1 < rows.length) {
        const nextCell = (rows[j+1].cells[c] ?? "").trim();
        if (nextCell === cell) j++;
        else break;
      }
      const startSlot = clampInt(rows[i].slot, 1, slotsPerDay, 0);
      const endSlot = clampInt(rows[j].slot, 1, slotsPerDay, 0);
      // validate
      if (day < 1 || day > 7 || startSlot === 0 || startSlot > slotsPerDay || endSlot < startSlot || endSlot > slotsPerDay) {
        droppedCount++;
      } else {
        const { name, location, weeks } = splitCell(cell);
        if (name) {
          courses.push({ name, day, startSlot, endSlot, weeks, location, teacher: "" });
        } else {
          droppedCount++;
        }
      }
      i = j + 1;
    }
  }

  courses.sort((a, b) => a.day - b.day || a.startSlot - b.startSlot);
  return { courses, droppedCount };
}
```

```ts
function asInt(v: unknown): number {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return NaN;
  if (typeof v === "number") return Math.round(v);
  if (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() !== "") {
    const n = Number(v);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(n) : NaN;
  }
  return NaN;
}
```

```ts
function extractLocation(text: string): { name: string; location: string } {
  // 末尾的「楼/室/馆/场」+ 可选编号，作为地点
  const m = text.match(/^(.*?)([\u4e00-\u9fa5A-Za-z0-9]*[楼室馆场][0-9A-Za-z-]*)$/);
  if (m) {
    return { name: m[1].trim(), location: m[2].trim() };
  }
  return { name: text.trim(), location: "" };
}
```

Let me define the splitCell order:
1. Split "@" (if present): name-part before last @, location after.

Let me write it:

```ts
function splitCell(text: string): { name: string; location: string; weeks: string } {
  let name = text.trim();
  let location = "";

  const atIdx = name.lastIndexOf("@");
  if (atIdx !== -1) {
    location = name.slice(atIdx + 1).trim();
    name = name.slice(0, atIdx).trim();
  } else {
    const m = name.match(/^(.*?)([\u4e00-\u9fa5A-Za-z0-9]*[楼室馆场][0-9A-Za-z-]*)$/);
    if (m) {
      name = m[1].trim();
      location = m[2].trim();
    }
  }

  // 去掉括号内的序号后缀（如「体育（一）」→「体育」）
  name = name.replace(/[（(]\s*[一二三四五六七八九十\d]\s*[)）]\s*$/, "").trim();

  // 提取周次
  let weeks = "";
  const weekMatch = name.match(/(非本周|单周|双周|第[0-9一二三四五六七八九十]+周|[0-9]+-[0-9]+周?)/);
  if (weekMatch) {
    weeks = weekMatch[1];
    name = name.replace(weekMatch[0], "").trim();
  }

  return { name, location, weeks };
}
```

Starting `.*?` = "", location group must match whole string from start. `[\u4e00-\u9fa5A-Za-z0-9]{0,4}` can match "Java" (4 chars) then `[楼室馆场]` must match next char "程" → fail (程 is not 楼/室/馆/场). Backtrack `{0,4}` to 3 chars "Jav", `[楼室馆场]` next "a" → fail. ... down to 0 chars, `[楼室馆场]` next "J" → fail. So `.*?` = "" fails entirely. `.*?` grows one char at a time.

Eventually `.*?` reaches a point where location group matches. The FIRST successful split (minimal `.*?`) wins. The location group `[\u4e00-\u9fa5A-Za-z0-9]{0,4}[楼室馆场][0-9A-Za-z-]*$` — the `[楼室馆场]` must be followed by `[0-9A-Za-z-]*$` (to end). 

For "Java程序设计实训楼305", the only 楼/室/馆/场 is "楼" at position 10. After "楼" is "305" (matches `[0-9A-Za-z-]*$`). Before "楼", `{0,4}` matches up to 4 chars. So location = (up to 4 chars before 楼) + "楼" + "305". The greedy `{0,4}` tries 4 chars: positions 6-9 = "设计实训". So location = "设计实训楼305", and `.*?` = "Java程序" (positions 0-5).

Let me finalize splitCell:

```ts
const LOCATION_RE = /^[\u4e00-\u9fa5A-Za-z0-9]{0,6}[楼室馆场][0-9A-Za-z-]{0,8}$/;

function splitCell(text: string): { name: string; location: string; weeks: string } {
  let name = text.trim();
  let location = "";
  let weeks = "";

  // 1) 以最后一个 "@" 为界，之后是地点
  const atIdx = name.lastIndexOf("@");
  if (atIdx !== -1) {
    location = name.slice(atIdx + 1).trim();
    name = name.slice(0, atIdx).trim();
  } else {
    // 2) 最后一个空白分隔的词若是「楼/室/馆/场」形态，视为地点
    const tokens = name.split(/\s+/);
    const last = tokens[tokens.length - 1] ?? "";
    if (tokens.length > 1 && LOCATION_RE.test(last)) {
      location = last;
      tokens.pop();
      name = tokens.join(" ");
    }
  }

  // 3) 去掉括号内的序号后缀（「体育（一）」→「体育」）
  name = name.replace(/[（(]\s*[一二三四五六七八九十\d]+\s*[)）]\s*$/g, "").trim();

  // 4) 提取周次
  const weekMatch = name.match(/(非本周|单周|双周|全周|第[0-9一二三四五六七八九十]+周|[0-9]+-[0-9]+周?)/);
  if (weekMatch) {
    weeks = weekMatch[1];
    name = name.replace(weekMatch[0], "").trim();
  }

  return { name, location, weeks };
}
```

Let me carefully write the vertical merge logic and validation.

```ts
export function gridToCourses(data: unknown): { courses: Course[]; droppedCount: number } {
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object") {
    return { courses: [], droppedCount: 0 };
  }
  const d = data as Record<string, unknown>;
  const slotsPerDay = clampInt(d.slotsPerDay, 1, 30, 12);

  const columnsRaw = Array.isArray(d.columns) ? d.columns : [];
  const columns: { index: number; label: string }[] = columnsRaw.map((c) => {
    const o = (c ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
      index: asInt(o.index),
      label: typeof o.label === "string" ? o.label.trim() : "",
    };
  });

  const rowsRaw = Array.isArray(d.rows) ? d.rows : [];
  const rows: { slot: number; cells: string[] }[] = rowsRaw.map((r) => {
    const o = (r ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
      slot: asInt(o.slot),
      cells: Array.isArray(o.cells) ? o.cells.map((cell) => (typeof cell === "string" ? cell : "")) : [],
    };
  });

  const courses: Course[] = [];
  let droppedCount = 0;

  for (let c = 0; c < columns.length; c++) {
    const day = columns[c].index;
    // 纵向扫描该列，合并相邻相同文字
    let i = 0;
    while (i < rows.length) {
      const cellText = (rows[i].cells[c] ?? "").trim();
      if (!cellText) {
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      let j = i;
      while (j + 1 < rows.length && (rows[j + 1].cells[c] ?? "").trim() === cellText) {
        j++;
      }
      const startSlot = rows[i].slot;
      const endSlot = rows[j].slot;
      // 校验
      const dayOk = Number.isInteger(day) && day >= 1 && day <= 7;
      const startOk = Number.isInteger(startSlot) && startSlot >= 1 && startSlot <= slotsPerDay;
      const endOk = Number.isInteger(endSlot) && endSlot >= 1 && endSlot <= slotsPerDay;
      const rangeOk = Number.isInteger(startSlot) && Number.isInteger(endSlot) && endSlot >= startSlot;

      if (!dayOk || !startOk || !endOk || !rangeOk) {
        droppedCount++;
      } else {
        const { name, location, weeks } = splitCell(cellText);
        if (name) {
          courses.push({ name, day, startSlot, endSlot, weeks, location, teacher: "" });
        } else {
          droppedCount++;
        }
      }
      i = j + 1;
    }
  }

  courses.sort((a, b) => a.day - b.day || a.startSlot - b.startSlot);
  return { courses, droppedCount };
}
```

This looks correct. Note: `day` is `asInt(columns[c].index)` which is a number or NaN. `Number.isInteger(day)` checks validity.

Let me write asInt:
```ts
function asInt(v: unknown): number {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return NaN;
  if (typeof v === "number") return Math.round(v);
  if (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() !== "") {
    const n = Number(v);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(n) : NaN;
  }
  return NaN;
}
```

clampInt:
```ts
function clampInt(v: unknown, min: number, max: number, fallback: number): number {
  const n = asInt(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return fallback;
  if (n < min) return min;
  if (n > max) return max;
  return n;
}
```

Now the weeks regex and bracket removal. Let me finalize splitCell:

```ts
function splitCell(text: string): { name: string; location: string; weeks: string } {
  let name = text.trim();
  let location = "";
  let weeks = "";

  // 1) 以最后一个 "@" 为界，之后是地点
  const atIdx = name.lastIndexOf("@");
  if (atIdx !== -1) {
    location = name.slice(atIdx + 1).trim();
    name = name.slice(0, atIdx).trim();
  } else {
    // 2) 最后一个空白分隔的词若像「楼/室/馆/场」形态，视为地点
    const tokens = name.split(/\s+/);
    const last = tokens[tokens.length - 1] ?? "";
    if (tokens.length > 1 && LOCATION_RE.test(last)) {
      location = last;
      tokens.pop();
      name = tokens.join(" ");
    }
  }

  // 3) 去掉括号内的序号后缀（「体育（一）」→「体育」）
  name = name.replace(/[（(]\s*[一二三四五六七八九十\d]+\s*[)）]\s*$/g, "").trim();

  // 4) 提取周次
  const weekMatch = name.match(/(非本周|单周|双周|全周|第[0-9一二三四五六七八九十]+周|[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}周)/);
  if (weekMatch) {
    weeks = weekMatch[1];
    name = name.replace(weekMatch[0], "").trim();
  }

  return { name, location, weeks };
}
```

Wait, the bracket removal: I need to be careful the regex removes trailing "（一）" only. `/[（(]\s*[一二三四五六七八九十\d]+\s*[)）]\s*$/g` — the `$` anchor with `\s*` before it. Actually `[)）]\s*$` means `)` then optional whitespace then end. Good.

But there's a subtlety: `[一二三四五六七八九十\d]+` is greedy and matches "一" (1 char). For "（十二）", matches "十二". Good.

Now, one concern: `name.replace(...).trim()` — if name becomes empty after removing bracket (e.g., cell is just "（一）"), name = "". Then in gridToCourses, `if (name)` is false → dropped. Good.

```ts
function buildData(raw: unknown): RecognizeData {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") {
    throw new RecognError("JSON 解析失败：模型返回结构异常");
  }
  const d = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const slotsPerDay = clampInt(d.slotsPerDay, 1, 30, 12);

  const periodsRaw = Array.isArray(d.periods) ? d.periods : [];
  const periods = periodsRaw
    .map((p) => {
      const o = (p ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      return {
        slot: clampInt(o.slot, 1, slotsPerDay, 0),
        start: typeof o.start === "string" ? o.start.trim() : "",
        end: typeof o.end === "string" ? o.end.trim() : "",
      };
    })
    .filter((p) => p.slot > 0);

  const { courses, droppedCount } = gridToCourses(raw);

  return { slotsPerDay, periods, courses, grid: raw, droppedCount };
}
```

```ts
/** 程序侧把模型返回的网格规整成最终结构，并调用 gridToCourses 换算坐标。 */
function buildData(raw: unknown): {
  slotsPerDay: number;
  periods: { slot: number; start: string; end: string }[];
  courses: Course[];
  grid: unknown;
  droppedCount: number;
} {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") {
    throw new RecognError("JSON 解析失败：模型返回结构异常");
  }
  const d = raw as Record<string, unknown>;

  const slotsPerDay = clampInt(d.slotsPerDay, 1, 30, 12);

  const periodsRaw = Array.isArray(d.periods) ? d.periods : [];
  const periods = periodsRaw
    .map((p) => {
      const o = (p ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      return {
        slot: clampInt(o.slot, 1, slotsPerDay, 0),
        start: typeof o.start === "string" ? o.start.trim() : "",
        end: typeof o.end === "string" ? o.end.trim() : "",
      };
    })
    .filter((p) => p.slot > 0);

  const { courses, droppedCount } = gridToCourses(raw);

  return {
    slotsPerDay,
    periods,
    courses,
    grid: raw,
    droppedCount,
  };
}
```

```tsx
const buildEvents = (): ScheduleEvent[] =>
  rows
    .filter((r) => r.name.trim())
    .map((r): ScheduleEvent => {
      const startSlot = clampSlot(r.startSlot);
      const endSlot = Math.max(startSlot, clampSlot(r.endSlot));
      const start = slotToRange(startSlot);
      const end = slotToRange(endSlot);
      return {
        id: genId(),
        title: r.name.trim(),
        date: dateKey(addDays(weekStart, r.day - 1)),
        startMin: start.startMin,
        endMin: end.endMin,
        kind: "course",
        location: r.location.trim() || undefined,
        unverified: true,
      };
    });

const handleConfirm = (mode: "append" | "replace") => {
  const events = buildEvents();
  if (events.length === 0) {
    close();
    return;
  }
  if (mode === "replace") {
    const ok = window.confirm(
      `将删除当前课表中的 ${courseCount} 门课程（不影响你自己添加的任务与计划），并导入新的 ${events.length} 门课。确定吗？`,
    );
    if (!ok) return;
  }
  onImport(events, mode);
  setStatus("idle");
  setRows([]);
  setDroppedCount(0);
};
```

**User**

改 /api/recognize 的输出契约：让模型抄格子，坐标由程序算。

背景（实测数据）:
用真实课表截图测试：模型返回的 periods 10/10 全对、课程名 10/10 全对，
但 day 全部输出 1、startSlot 按 1,3,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,11 递增 ——
它把二维课表当成一列从上往下读，完全没有理解「列 = 星期」。
因此星期正确 2/10、节次正确 1/10。

【一】提示词改为要求输出网格，不再要求模型判断 day/startSlot/endSlot

{
  "slotsPerDay": number,
  "periods": [{ "slot": number, "start": string, "end": string }],
  "columns": [{ "index": number, "label": string }],
  "rows": [{ "slot": number, "cells": string[] }]
}

提示词里必须写清：
- columns 按图片从左到右列出表头文字（如 一/二/三 或 星期一…星期日），
  index 从 1 开始，1=周一 … 7=周日。表头带日期数字（如「一 9」「9」）时忽略数字。
- rows 按图片从上到下，slot 取左侧节次编号（1,2,3…）；
  左侧若同时印有具体时间，一并填入 periods。
- cells 的长度必须等于 columns 的长度，一一对应；
  每个格子放该格内的全部文字（课程名、地点、周次都保留原文，用空格分隔）。
- 空格子用空字符串 ""。
- 不要做任何"这门课属于星期几"的判断，那是程序的事，做了反而会错。
- 只输出这一个 JSON，不要解释文字。

【二】新增 lib/gridToCourses.ts（纯函数）
export function gridToCourses(data): { courses: Course[]; droppedCount: number }

1. 用 columns[i].index 建立「列下标 → 星期」映射
2. 遍历每行每列，跳过空 cell
3. 纵向合并：同一列里相邻行、去掉首尾空格后文字完全相同的 cell → 视为同一门课，
   startSlot 取第一条 slot，endSlot 取最后一条 slot
4. 把 cell 文字拆成 name / location / weeks：
   - 含 "@" 时：最后一个 "@" 之后为 location，之前为 name
   - 否则若末尾出现「楼+数字」「室+数字」「馆」模式，作为 location，其余为 name
   - name 去掉括号内的序号后缀（「体育（一）」→「体育」）
   - 含「非本周」「单周」「双周」等字样时写入 weeks，并从 name 中移除
5. 产出 Course { name, day, startSlot, endSlot, weeks, location, teacher: "" }
6. 校验：day 在 1..7、slot 在 1..slotsPerDay、endSlot >= startSlot，
   不合法丢弃并计数

【三】/api/recognize 返回结构
{ ok, data: { slotsPerDay, periods, courses, grid }, droppedCount }
- courses 由 gridToCourses 从网格算出
- grid 保留模型

因此星期正确 2/10、节次正确 1/10。

【一】提示词改为要求输出网格，不再要求模型判断 day/startSlot/endSlot

{
  "slotsPerDay": number,
  "periods": [{ "slot": number, "start": string, "end": string }],
  "columns": [{ "index": number, "label": string }],
  "rows": [{ "slot": number, "cells": string[] }]
}

提示词里必须写清：
- columns 按图片从左到右列出表头文字（如 一/二/三 或 星期一…星期日），
  index 从 1 开始，1=周一 … 7=周日。表头带日期数字（如「一 9」「9」）时忽略数字。
- rows 按图片从上到下，slot 取左侧节次编号（1,2,3…）；
  左侧若同时印有具体时间，一并填入 periods。
- cells 的长度必须等于 columns 的长度，一一对应；
  每个格子放该格内的全部文字（课程名、地点、周次都保留原文，用空格分隔）。
- 空格子用空字符串 ""。
- 不要做任何"这门课属于星期几"的判断，那是程序的事，做了反而会错。
- 只输出这一个 JSON，不要解释文字。

【二】新增 lib/gridToCourses.ts（纯函数）
export function gridToCourses(data): { courses: Course[]; droppedCount: number }

1. 用 columns[i].index 建立「列下标 → 星期」映射
2. 遍历每行每列，跳过空 cell
3. 纵向合并：同一列里相邻行、去掉首尾空格后文字完全相同的 cell → 视为同一门课，
   startSlot 取第一条 slot，endSlot 取最后一条 slot
4. 把 cell 文字拆成 name / location / weeks：
   - 含 "@" 时：最后一个 "@" 之后为 location，之前为 name
   - 否则若末尾出现「楼+数字」「室+数字」「馆」模式，作为 location，其余为 name
   - name 去掉括号内的序号后缀（「体育（一）」→「体育」）
   - 含「非本周」「单周」「双周」等字样时写入 weeks，并从 name 中移除
5. 产出 Course { name, day, startSlot, endSlot, weeks, location, teacher: "" }
6. 校验：day 在 1..7、slot 在 1..slotsPerDay、endSlot >= startSlot，
   不合法丢弃并计数

【三】/api/recognize 返回结构
{ ok, data: { slotsPerDay, periods, courses, grid }, droppedCount }
- courses 由 gridToCourses 从网格算出
- grid 保留模型原始网格，便于排查（前端暂不使用）
- 前端 ImportTimetable 不需要改，它只消费 data.courses 与 data.periods

The new pure function:

```ts
export interface Course {
  name: string;
  day: number;
  startSlot: number;
  endSlot: number;
  weeks: string;
  location: string;
  teacher: string;
}

export interface CourseBlock {
  name: string;
  col: number;
  rowStart: number;
  rowEnd: number;
  location: string;
  weeks: string;
}

function asInt(v: unknown): number { ... }

function clampInt(v, min, max, fallback) { ... }

export function blocksToCourses(data: unknown): { courses: Course[]; invalidCount: number } {
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object") return { courses: [], invalidCount: 0 };
  const d = data as Record<string, unknown>;
  const slotsPerDay = clampInt(d.slotsPerDay, 1, 30, 12);
  const blocksRaw = Array.isArray(d.blocks) ? d.blocks : [];
  let invalidCount = 0;
  const courses: Course[] = [];

  for (const raw of blocksRaw) {
    const o = (raw ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const name = typeof o.name === "string" ? o.name.trim() : "";
    if (!name) {
      invalidCount++;
      continue;
    }
    let col = clampInt(o.col, 1, 7, 1); // 夹取
    let rowStart = clampInt(o.rowStart, 1, slotsPerDay, 1);
    let rowEnd = clampInt(o.rowEnd, 1, slotsPerDay, rowStart);

    // 校验并夹取，非法计入 invalidCount
    const colRaw = asInt(o.col);
    if (!Number.isFinite(colRaw) || colRaw < 1 || colRaw > 7) invalidCount++;
    const rowStartRaw = asInt(o.rowStart);
    if (!Number.isFinite(rowStartRaw) || rowStartRaw < 1 || rowStartRaw > slotsPerDay) invalidCount++;
    const rowEndRaw = asInt(o.rowEnd);
    if (!Number.isFinite(rowEndRaw) || rowEndRaw < 1 || rowEndRaw > slotsPerDay) invalidCount++;
    if (Number.isFinite(rowEndRaw) && Number.isFinite(rowStartRaw) && rowEndRaw < rowStartRaw) {
      invalidCount++;
      rowEnd = rowStart;
    }

    const location = typeof o.location === "string" ? o.location.trim() : "";
    let weeks = typeof o.weeks === "string" ? o.weeks.trim() : "";

    // weeks 含「非本周」保留
    // （契约里模型把非本周/单周/双周写进 weeks，程序直接保留）

    courses.push({
      name,
      day: col,
      startSlot: rowStart,
      endSlot: rowEnd,
      weeks,
      location,
      teacher: "",
    });
  }

  courses.sort((a, b) => a.day - b.day || a.startSlot - b.startSlot);
  return { courses, invalidCount };
}
```

```ts
function clampWithFlag(v: unknown, min: number, max: number, fallback: number): { value: number; invalid: boolean } {
  const n = asInt(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return { value: fallback, invalid: true };
  if (n < min) return { value: min, invalid: true };
  if (n > max) return { value: max, invalid: true };
  return { value: n, invalid: false };
}
```

```ts

if (col.invalid) invalidCount++;

const rowStart = clampWithFlag(o.rowStart, 1, slotsPerDay, 1);
if (rowStart.invalid) invalidCount++;

const rowEnd = clampWithFlag(o.rowEnd, 1, slotsPerDay, rowStart.value);
if (rowEnd.invalid) invalidCount++;

let endSlot = rowEnd.value;
if (endSlot < rowStart.value) {
  endSlot = rowStart.value;
  invalidCount++;
}
```

Current handleImport (line 485-504):
```ts
const handleImport = (newEvents: ScheduleEvent[], mode: "append" | "replace") => {
  let next: ScheduleEvent[];
  let keptCount = 0;
  if (mode === "replace") {
    const kept = events.filter((e) => e.kind !== "course");
    keptCount = kept.length;
    next = [...kept, ...newEvents];
  } else {
    next = [...events, ...newEvents];
  }
  setEvents(next);
  saveEvents(next);

  setImportNotice(
    mode === "replace"
      ? `已用 ${newEvents.length} 门课覆盖原课表（保留 ${keptCount} 个任务）`
      : `已追加 ${newEvents.length} 门课`,
  );
```

```ts
function validateActions(
  rawActions: unknown,
  freeSlots: FreeSlotInput[],
): { actions: GoalAction[]; movedCount: number; droppedCount: number } {
  const list = Array.isArray(rawActions) ? rawActions : [];
  const kept: GoalAction[] = [];
  let droppedCount = 0;
  // 已占用区间表：按 date 分组的 [startMin, endMin] 列表
  const occupied = new Map<string, [number, number][]>();

  for (const raw of list) {
    const a = (raw ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const idx = asInt(a.freeSlotIndex);
    const offsetMin = asInt(a.offsetMin);
    const durationMin = asInt(a.durationMin);
    const title = typeof a.title === "string" ? a.title.trim() : "";
    const detail = typeof a.detail === "string" ? a.detail.trim() : "";

    if (!title) { droppedCount++; continue; }
    if (!Number.isFinite(idx) || idx < 0 || idx >= freeSlots.length) { droppedCount++; continue; }
    if (!Number.isFinite(offsetMin) || offsetMin < 0) { droppedCount++; continue; }
    if (!Number.isFinite(durationMin) || durationMin < 30 || durationMin > 120) { droppedCount++; continue; }

    const slot = freeSlots[idx];
    const startMin = slot.startMin + offsetMin;
    const endMin = startMin + durationMin;

    // 边界校验：endMin 不得超过该空档 endMin
    if (endMin > slot.endMin) { droppedCount++; continue; }

    // 与已占用区间不相交
    const dayOccupied = occupied.get(slot.date) ?? [];
    const intersects = dayOccupied.some(
      ([s, e]) => startMin < e && endMin > s,
    );
    if (intersects) { droppedCount++; continue; }

    // 记录占用
    dayOccupied.push([startMin, endMin]);
    occupied.set(slot.date, dayOccupied);

    kept.push({
      op: "add",
      date: slot.date,
      startMin,
      endMin,
      title,
      kind: "task",
      detail,
    });
  }

  // 同一天累计时长控制：> 240 分钟丢弃最晚的
  const byDate = new Map<string, GoalAction[]>();
  for (const act of kept) {
    const arr = byDate.get(act.date) ?? [];
    arr.push(act);
    byDate.set(act.date, arr);
  }
  const final: GoalAction[] = [];
  for (const arr of byDate.values()) {
    arr.sort((x, y) => x.startMin - y.startMin || x.endMin - y.endMin);
    let total = arr.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.endMin - x.startMin), 0);
    const remaining = [...arr];
    while (total > MAX_DAILY_MIN && remaining.length > 0) {
      const latest = remaining.pop()!;
      total -= latest.endMin - latest.startMin;
      droppedCount++;
    }
    final.push(...remaining);
  }

  final.sort((x, y) => x.date === y.date ? x.startMin - y.startMin : x.date < y.date ? -1 : 1);

  return { actions: final, movedCount: 0, droppedCount };
}
```

```ts
  let droppedCount = 0;

  // 超过 12 条：按时间顺序（空档日期 + 偏移）排序后截断，多余的计入 droppedCount。
  let list: unknown[] = rawList;
  if (rawList.length > 12) {
    const indexed = rawList.map((raw, i) => {
      const a = (raw ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const idx = asInt(a.freeSlotIndex);
      const off = asInt(a.offsetMin);
      const slot =
        Number.isFinite(idx) && idx >= 0 && idx < freeSlots.length ? freeSlots[idx] : null;
      const start =
        slot && Number.isFinite(off) ? slot.startMin + off : slot ? slot.startMin : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
      return { raw, date: slot?.date ?? "", start, i };
    });
    indexed.sort((x, y) =>
      x.date === y.date ? x.start - y.start : x.date < y.date ? -1 : 1,
    );
    droppedCount += indexed.length - 12;
    list = indexed.slice(0, 12).map((x) => x.raw);
  }

  // ... main loop ...
}
```

```
/**
 * 找到「时间上最接近」且长度足够的空闲块：
 * 距离 = 日期相差天数 * 1440 + 开始分钟差值；取距离最小者。
 * 找不到（长度都不够）返回 null。
 */
function findClosestSlot(
  startMin: number,
  date: string,
  duration: number,
  freeSlots: FreeSlotInput[],
): FreeSlotInput | null {
  let best: FreeSlotInput | null = null;
  let bestDist = Infinity;
  for (const slot of freeSlots) {
    if (slot.endMin - slot.startMin < duration) continue;
    const dist = daysBetween(date, slot.date) * 1440 + Math.abs(slot.startMin - startMin);
    if (dist < bestDist) {
      bestDist = dist;
      best = slot;
    }
  }
  return best;
}
```

New validateActions:

```ts
/**
 * 程序侧完成时段校验：
 * 1. 逐条把 freeSlotIndex + offsetMin + durationMin 换算成 date/startMin/endMin。
 * 2. 校验：下标合法、时长 30-120、区间不超出空档、不与已占用区间重叠。
 *    通过则记入已占用表；不通过丢弃（droppedCount++）。
 * 3. 超过 12 条 → 按时间顺序截断，多余的计入 droppedCount。
 * 4. 同一天累计时长 > 240 分钟 → 丢弃该天最晚的子任务，直到不再超。
 */
function validateActions(
  rawActions: unknown,
  freeSlots: FreeSlotInput[],
): { actions: GoalAction[]; movedCount: number; droppedCount: number } {
  const rawList = Array.isArray(rawActions) ? rawActions : [];
  let droppedCount = 0;

  // 超过 12 条：按时间顺序（空档下标 + 偏移）排序后截断，多余的计入 droppedCount。
  let list: unknown[] = rawList;
  if (rawList.length > 12) {
    const indexed = rawList.map((raw) => {
      const a = (raw ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const idx = asInt(a.freeSlotIndex);
      const off = asInt(a.offsetMin);
      return {
        raw,
        idx: Number.isFinite(idx) ? idx : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
        off: Number.isFinite(off) ? off : 0,
      };
    });
    indexed.sort((x, y) => x.idx - y.idx || x.off - y.off);
    droppedCount += indexed.length - 12;
    list = indexed.slice(0, 12).map((x) => x.raw);
  }

  const kept: GoalAction[] = [];
  // 已占用区间表：按 date 分组，用于保证同一空档内任务不重叠。
  const occupied = new Map<string, [number, number][]>();

  for (const raw of list) {
    const a = (raw ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const idx = asInt(a.freeSlotIndex);
    const offsetMin = asInt(a.offsetMin);
    const durationMin = asInt(a.durationMin);
    const title = typeof a.title === "string" ? a.title.trim() : "";
    const detail = typeof a.detail === "string" ? a.detail.trim() : "";

    if (!title) {
      droppedCount++;
      continue;
    }
    // 下标合法
    if (!Number.isFinite(idx) || idx < 0 || idx >= freeSlots.length) {
      droppedCount++;
      continue;
    }
    // 时长 30-120
    if (!Number.isFinite(durationMin) || durationMin < 30 || durationMin > 120) {
      droppedCount++;
      continue;
    }
    // 偏移非负
    if (!Number.isFinite(offsetMin) || offsetMin < 0) {
      droppedCount++;
      continue;
    }

    const slot = freeSlots[idx];
    const startMin = slot.startMin + offsetMin;
    const endMin = startMin + durationMin;

    // 不超出该空档边界
    if (endMin > slot.endMin) {
      droppedCount++;
      continue;
    }
    // 不与已占用区间相交
    const dayOccupied = occupied.get(slot.date) ?? [];
    const overlaps = dayOccupied.some(([s, e]) => startMin < e && endMin > s);
    if (overlaps) {
      droppedCount++;
      continue;
    }

    dayOccupied.push([startMin, endMin]);
    occupied.set(slot.date, dayOccupied);

    kept.push({
      op: "add",
      date: slot.date,
      startMin,
      endMin,
      title,
      kind: "task",
      detail,
    });
  }

  // 同一天累计时长控制：按开始时间升序，超时从最晚的开始丢。
  const byDate = new Map<string, GoalAction[]>();
  for (const act of kept) {
    const arr = byDate.get(act.date) ?? [];
    arr.push(act);
    byDate.set(act.date, arr);
  }

  const final: GoalAction[] = [];
  for (const arr of byDate.values()) {
    arr.sort((x, y) => x.startMin - y.startMin || x.endMin - y.endMin);
    let total = arr.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.endMin - x.startMin), 0);
    const remaining = [...arr];
    while (total > MAX_DAILY_MIN && remaining.length > 0) {
      const latest = remaining.pop()!;
      total -= latest.endMin - latest.startMin;
      droppedCount++;
    }
    final.push(...remaining);
  }

  final.sort((x, y) =>
    x.date === y.date ? x.startMin - y.startMin : x.date < y.date ? -1 : 1,
  );

  return { actions: final, movedCount: 0, droppedCount };
}
```

```ts
function asInt(v: unknown): number {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return NaN;
  if (typeof v === "number") return Math.round(v);
  if (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() !== "") {
    const n = Number(v);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(n) : NaN;
  }
  return NaN;
}
```

Let me now design the new blocksToCourses:

```ts
export function blocksToCourses(
  data: unknown,
): { courses: Course[]; invalidCount: number } {
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object") {
    return { courses: [], invalidCount: 0 };
  }
  const d = data as Record<string, unknown>;
  const slotCount = clampInt(d.slotCount, 1, 30, 11);
  const colCount = clampInt(d.colCount, 1, 7, 7); // colCount 缺失默认 7，也夹到 1..7

  const blocksRaw = Array.isArray(d.blocks) ? d.blocks : [];
  const courses: Course[] = [];
  let invalidCount = 0;

  for (const raw of blocksRaw) {
    const o = (raw ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const name = typeof o.name === "string" ? o.name.trim() : "";
    if (!name) {
      invalidCount++;
      continue;
    }

    // 四个比例：不是 0..1 的有限数 → 夹到 [0,1] 并计入 invalidCount。
    const leftRatio = clampRatio(o.leftRatio);
    const rightRatio = clampRatio(o.rightRatio);
    const topRatio = clampRatio(o.topRatio);
    const bottomRatio = clampRatio(o.bottomRatio);
    if (leftRatio.invalid) invalidCount++;
    if (rightRatio.invalid) invalidCount++;
    if (topRatio.invalid) invalidCount++;
    if (bottomRatio.invalid) invalidCount++;

    // 换算行列
    const centerRatio = (leftRatio.value + rightRatio.value) / 2;
    const col = clampInt(Math.round(centerRatio * colCount) + 1, 1, colCount, 1);
    let startSlot = clampInt(Math.round(topRatio.value * slotCount) + 1, 1, slotCount, 1);
    let endSlot = clampInt(Math.round(bottomRatio.value * slotCount), 1, slotCount, startSlot);
    if (endSlot < startSlot) {
      endSlot = startSlot;
      invalidCount++;
    }

    const location = typeof o.location === "string" ? o.location.trim() : "";
    const weeks = typeof o.weeks === "string" ? o.weeks.trim() : "";

    courses.push({
      name,
      day: col,
      startSlot,
      endSlot,
      weeks,
      location,
      teacher: "",
    });
  }

  courses.sort((a, b) => a.day - b.day || a.startSlot - b.startSlot);
  return { courses, invalidCount };
}
```

```ts
function clampRatio(v: unknown): { value: number; invalid: boolean } {
  const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : NaN;
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return { value: 0, invalid: true };
  if (n < 0) return { value: 0, invalid: true };
  if (n > 1) return { value: 1, invalid: true };
  return { value: n, invalid: false };
}
```

```ts
function toRatio(v: unknown): number {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return NaN;
  if (typeof v === "number") return v;
  if (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() !== "") {
    const n = Number(v);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : NaN;
  }
  return NaN;
}

function clampRatio(v: unknown): { value: number; invalid: boolean } {
  const n = toRatio(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return { value: 0, invalid: true };
  if (n < 0) return { value: 0, invalid: true };
  if (n > 1) return { value: 1, invalid: true };
  return { value: n, invalid: false };
}
```

Let me write computePosition logic in useLayoutEffect:

```ts
useLayoutEffect(() => {
  const el = ref.current;
  if (!el) return;
  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  const vw = window.innerWidth;
  const vh = window.innerHeight;
  let left = anchor.x + GAP;
  let top = anchor.y;
  // 右侧放不下 → 翻到左侧

  }
  // 下方放不下 → 翻到上方
  if (top + rect.height > vh - 8) {
    top = anchor.y - rect.height;
  }
  left = Math.max(8, Math.min(left, vw - rect.width - 8));
  top = Math.max(8, Math.min(top, vh - rect.height - 8));
  el.style.left = `${left}px`;
  el.style.top = `${top}px`;
}, [anchor]);
```

Let me write guessKind.ts:

```ts
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "./types";

/**
 * 根据日期与开始时间猜测事件类型与默认时长（纯函数）。
 * - 周一至周五 08:00-17:40 且开始时间落在该区间 → course，90 分钟
 * - 其余（晚上、周末，含周末白天）→ task，60 分钟
 */
export function guessKind(
  date: string,
  startMin: number,
): { kind: ScheduleEvent["kind"]; durationMin: number } {
  const [y, m, d] = date.split("-").map(Number);
  const dow = new Date(y, m - 1, d).getDay(); // 0=周日 … 6=周六
  const isWeekday = dow >= 1 && dow <= 5;
  const inDaytime = startMin >= 8 * 60 && startMin <= 17 * 60 + 40;
  if (isWeekday && inDaytime) {
    return { kind: "course", durationMin: 90 };
  }
  return { kind: "task", durationMin: 60 };
}
```

Let me structure QuickAdd:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ScheduleEvent } from "@/lib/types";

const DURATIONS = [
  { value: 30, label: "30 分" },
  { value: 60, label: "1 小时" },
  { value: 90, label: "1.5 小时" },
  { value: 120, label: "2 小时" },
];

const GAP = 8;

type QuickAddProps = {
  date: string;
  startMin: number;
  kind: ScheduleEvent["kind"];
  durationMin: number;
  anchor: { x: number; y: number };
  onSave: (data: { title: string; kind: ScheduleEvent["kind"]; durationMin: number }) => void;
  onMore: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
};

export default function QuickAdd({ date, startMin, kind, durationMin, anchor, onSave, onMore, onClose }: QuickAddProps) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(durationMin);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const bubbleRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  // Esc 关闭
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [onClose]);

  // 定位：默认在锚点右侧，放不下则翻到左侧 / 上方（直接改 DOM，避免 effect 里 setState）。
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = bubbleRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vw = window.innerWidth;
    const vh = window.innerHeight;
    let left = anchor.x + GAP;
    let top = anchor.y;
    if (left + rect.width > vw - GAP) left = anchor.x - rect.width - GAP;
    if (top + rect.height > vh - GAP) top = anchor.y - rect.height;
    left = Math.max(GAP, Math.min(left, vw - rect.width - GAP));
    top = Math.max(GAP, Math.min(top, vh - rect.height - GAP));
    el.style.left = `${left}px`;
    el.style.top = `${top}px`;
  }, [anchor]);

  const submit = () => {
    const t = title.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    onSave({ title: t, kind, durationMin: duration });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40" onClick={onClose} />
      <div
        ref={bubbleRef}
        className="fixed z-50 w-72 rounded-lg border border-line bg-white p-3 shadow-lg"
        style={{ left: anchor.x, top: anchor.y }}
      >
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          value={title}
          onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
              e.preventDefault();
              submit();
            }
          }}
          placeholder="要做什么？"
          className="w-full rounded-md border border-line bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition-colors focus:border-primary"
        />
        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1">
          {DURATIONS.map((d) => (
            <button
              key={d.value}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setDuration(d.value)}
              className={`h-7 flex-1 cursor-pointer rounded-md text-xs transition-colors ${
                duration === d.value
                  ? "bg-primary text-white"
                  : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200"
              }`}
            >
              {d.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400">
          <span>回车创建 · Esc 取消</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onMore}
            className="cursor-pointer text-primary hover:underline"
          >
            更多选项 →
```

**lib/history.ts:**

```ts
export type HistoryEntry = {
  label: string;
  undo: () => void;
  redo: () => void;
};

const MAX = 20;

class HistoryStack {
  private undoStack: HistoryEntry[] = [];
  private redoStack: HistoryEntry[] = [];

  push(entry: HistoryEntry): void {
    this.undoStack.push(entry);
    if (this.undoStack.length > MAX) {
      this.undoStack.shift();
    }
    this.redoStack = [];
  }

  undo(): HistoryEntry | null {
    const entry = this.undoStack.pop();
    if (!entry) return null;
    entry.undo();
    this.redoStack.push(entry);
    return entry;
  }

  redo(): HistoryEntry | null {
    const entry = this.redoStack.pop();
    if (!entry) return null;
    entry.redo();
    this.undoStack.push(entry);
    return entry;
  }
}
```

Actually, let me reconsider the history module design. The entry's `undo` and `redo` functions are closures provided by page.tsx's `commitEvents`. So:

```ts
// lib/history.ts
export type HistoryEntry = {
  label: string;
  undo: () => void;
  redo: () => void;
};

let undoStack: HistoryEntry[] = [];
let redoStack: HistoryEntry[] = [];
const MAX = 20;

export function pushHistory(entry: HistoryEntry): void {
  undoStack.push(entry);
  if (undoStack.length > MAX) undoStack.shift();
  redoStack = [];
}

export function undoHistory(): HistoryEntry | null {
  const entry = undoStack.pop();
  if (!entry) return null;
  entry.undo();
  redoStack.push(entry);
  return entry;
}

export function redoHistory(): HistoryEntry | null {
  const entry = redoStack.pop();
  if (!entry) return null;
  entry.redo();
  undoStack.push(entry);
  return entry;
}
```

This is a module-level singleton. Simple and lightweight.

```ts
    undo: () => {
      setEvents(prev);
      saveEvents(prev);
    },
    redo: () => {
      setEvents(next);
      saveEvents(next);
    },
  });
}, [events]);
```

**lib/history.ts:**

```ts
export type HistoryEntry = {
  label: string;
  undo: () => void;
  redo: () => void;
};

const MAX = 20;

let undoStack: HistoryEntry[] = [];
let redoStack: HistoryEntry[] = [];

/** 入栈一条操作，并把 redo 栈清空。 */
export function pushHistory(entry: HistoryEntry): void {
  undoStack.push(entry);
  if (undoStack.length > MAX) undoStack.shift();
  redoStack = [];
}

/** 撤销最近一条操作，返回该条（供展示 toast）。 */
export function undoHistory(): HistoryEntry | null {
  const entry = undoStack.pop();
  if (!entry) return null;
  entry.undo();
  redoStack.push(entry);
  return entry;
}

/** 重做最近一次撤销，返回该条。 */
export function redoHistory(): HistoryEntry | null {
  const entry = redoStack.pop();
  if (!entry) return null;
  entry.redo();
  undoStack.push(entry);
  return entry;
}
```

```ts
export type HistoryEntry = {
  label: string;
  undo: () => void;
  redo: () => void;
};

const MAX_HISTORY = 20;

let undoStack: HistoryEntry[] = [];
let redoStack: HistoryEntry[] = [];

export function pushHistory(entry: HistoryEntry): void {
  undoStack.push(entry);
  if (undoStack.length > MAX_HISTORY) {
    undoStack = undoStack.slice(-MAX_HISTORY);
  }
  redoStack = []; // 每次新操作后清空 redo 栈
}

export function undoHistory(): HistoryEntry | null {
  const entry = undoStack.pop();
  if (entry) {
    entry.undo();
    redoStack.push(entry);
    return entry;
  }
  return null;
}

export function redoHistory(): HistoryEntry | null {
  const entry = redoStack.pop();
  if (entry) {
    entry.redo();
    undoStack.push(entry);
    return entry;
  }
  return null;
}
```

```ts
        label,

          setEvents(prev);
          saveEvents(prev);

        redo: () => {

          saveEvents(next);
        },
      });
    },
    [events],
  );
```

```ts
  }, [handleUndo, handleRedo]);
```

```ts
export interface BlocksResult {
  courses: Course[];
  invalidCount: number;
  /** 模型识别到的列数（可能为 NaN）；调用方负责校验是否为 6 或 7。 */
  colCount: number;
  /** 课程数 >= 3 且所有课程都被识别成单节时置 true，提示「跨度未识别」。 */
  spanSuspect: boolean;
}

/**
 * 把模型返回的课程块列表转成课程列表。
 *
 * 换算公式（与提示词约定一致）：
 *   col       = clamp(floor(((leftRatio + rightRatio) / 2) * colCount) + 1, 1, colCount)
 *   startSlot = clamp(round(topRatio * slotCount) + 1, 1, slotCount)
 *   endSlot   = clamp(round(bottomRatio * slotCount), 1, slotCount)
 *   endSlot < startSlot → endSlot = startSlot
 *
 * 校验策略：比例越界一律「夹取」而非丢弃，只对空课程名直接丢弃；
 * 每次夹取 / 修正都计入 invalidCount，便于前端提示「已自动修正」。
 */
export function blocksToCourses(data: unknown): BlocksResult {
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object") {
    return { courses: [], invalidCount: 0, colCount: NaN, spanSuspect: false };
  }
  const d = data as Record<string, unknown>;

  // slotCount 不在 1..30 或缺失 → 默认 11。
  const slotCountRaw = toNumber(d.slotCount);
  const slotCount = Number.isFinite(slotCountRaw) ? clamp(slotCountRaw, 1, 30) : 11;
  // 列数不再静默夹到 7：保留识别值，由调用方校验（6/7 之外应失败而非压列）。
  const colCount = toNumber(d.colCount);
  const effectiveColCount = Number.isFinite(colCount) ? colCount : 7;

  const blocksRaw = Array.isArray(d.blocks) ? d.blocks : [];
  const courses: Course[] = [];
  let invalidCount = 0;

  for (const raw of blocksRaw) {
    const o = (raw ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const name = typeof o.name === "string" ? o.name.trim() : "";
    if (!name) {
      invalidCount++;
      continue;
    }

    const leftRatio = clampRatio(o.leftRatio);
    const rightRatio = clampRatio(o.rightRatio);
    const topRatio = clampRatio(o.topRatio);
    const bottomRatio = clampRatio(o.bottomRatio);
    if (leftRatio.invalid) invalidCount++;
    if (rightRatio.invalid) invalidCount++;
    if (topRatio.invalid) invalidCount++;
    if (bottomRatio.invalid) invalidCount++;

    const centerRatio = (leftRatio.value + rightRatio.value) / 2;
    // 第 k 列中心比例是 (k-0.5)/colCount，floor 后 +1 恰好还原为 k（round 会把前 6 列整体右移一列）。
    const col = clamp(Math.floor(centerRatio * effectiveColCount) + 1, 1, effectiveColCount);
    const startSlot = clamp(Math.round(topRatio.value * slotCount) + 1, 1, slotCount);
    let endSlot = clamp(Math.round(bottomRatio.value * slotCount), 1, slotCount);
    if (endSlot < startSlot) {
      endSlot = startSlot;
      invalidCount++;
    }

    const location = typeof o.location === "string" ? o.location.trim() : "";
    const weeks = typeof o.weeks === "string" ? o.weeks.trim() : "";

    courses.push({
      name,
      day: col,
      startSlot,
      endSlot,
      weeks,
      location,
      teacher: "",
    });
  }

  // 固定按「星期 → 起始节次」排序，避免模型输出顺序随机导致界面跳动。
  courses.sort((a, b) => a.day - b.day || a.startSlot - b.startSlot);

  // 所有课程都被识别成单节（endSlot === startSlot）时，说明「块高」没读出来：
  // 与其让界面看起来正常（每门课都短一截），不如显式标记可疑。
  const spanSuspect =
    courses.length >= 3 && courses.every((c) => c.endSlot === c.startSlot);

  return { courses, invalidCount, colCount, spanSuspect };
}
```

## 两点说明

1. **列换算已生效**：响应里出现了 `colCount: 7`、`spanSuspect: false`，这两个字段只有新代码才会返回，说明 fresh build 已跑通新逻辑。星期 50% 反映的是这张截图本身「块宽自适应、块边界与列边界错位」的已知难点，不是换算公式的锅。

2. **`spanSuspect` 没有触发是符合预期的**：模型把「程序设计基础」读成了 2 节（得 3-4），所以不是「全部单节」，`spanSuspect=false`。但节次跨度 0% 说明模型几乎没读出「块高」，其余 9 门都被读成了单节——这正好是【三】要拦截的静默失真，只是这条边界条件没命中。如果想让「大部分单节」也告警，需要把阈值从「全部」放宽，这超出本次范围，我没有擅自动。

POST {
  goal: { title, deadline, hoursPerWeek, priority },
  context: {
    today: string,              // 今天 YYYY-MM-DD
    freeHoursThisWeek: number,  // 程序算好的本周可用小时
    weeksUntilDeadline: number, // 程序算好的剩余周数（保留一位小数）

  }
}

返回 {
  ok: true,
  feasibility: {
    verdict: "可行" | "紧张" | "不可行",
    requiredHours: number,        // 达成目标大致需要的总小时
    supplyHours: number,          // 到截止日期的可用总小时 = hoursPerWeek * weeksUntilDeadline
    gapHours: number,             // 缺口（供 - 需），负数表示不足
    note: string                  // 一句中文说明
  },
  options: [{
    id: "A" | "B" | "C",
    name: string,                 // 如「分散式」「集中式」「冲刺式」
    strategy: "daily" | "weekly" | "sprint",
    summary: string,              // 一句话思路（20-40 字）
    sessionsPerWeek: number,
    avgSessionMin: number,
    totalHours: number,
    pros: string[],               // 2-3 条优点
    cons: string[],               // 2-3 条代价
    risk: string                  // 一句话风险提示
  }],
  recommendation: "A" | "B" | "C",
  recommendReason: string
}

提示词要点：
- 必须给 3 个方案，且 strategy 尽量不同：
  · daily   分散式：每天 30-60 分钟，持续整个周期（记忆最牢，但要求每天坚持）
  · weekly  集中式：每周 2-3 次，每次 90-120 分钟（单次深入，但间隔长易忘）
  · sprint  冲刺式：前段只打基础，后段高强度（前期压力小，后期风险高）
- 每个方案的 sessionsPerWeek × avgSessionMin × weeksUntilDeadline
  应接近 hoursPerWeek，不要超过；totalHours 由这些数字算出，不许编
- feasibility 必须用 context 里的 supplyHours 与你自己估的 requiredHours 比较，
  gapHours = supplyHours - requiredHours
- 若 supplyHours 明显不足（gap < -20% 的需），verdict 必须是「不可行」，
  并在 recommendReason 里给出三条可选的调整方向
- 不要输出任何事件、时间点、日期——这一轮只出方案
- actions 字段一个都不要有
- 限流 5 次/分；请求体上限 8KB；密钥只从环境变量读；错误出口脱敏

- weeksUntilDeadline: (deadline - today) / 7 days, rounded to 1 decimal. If no deadline, fallback to some default (e.g., 4). Let me compute:
```ts
function weeksUntil(deadline: string, today: string): number {
  if (!deadline) return 4;
  const d = new Date(deadline + "T00:00:00");
  const t = new Date(today + "T00:00:00");
  const diff = (d.getTime() - t.getTime()) / (7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);
  if (!Number.isFinite(diff) || diff <= 0) return 1;
  return Math.round(diff * 10) / 10;
}
```

```ts
const handleGoalPlan = async (goal: Goal) => {
  if (planningGoalId || advisingGoalId) return;
  setAdvisingGoalId(goal.id);
  setGoalPlanError("");
  setGoalPlanNotice("");

  try {
    const today = dateKey(new Date());
    const weekStartKey = dateKey(startOfWeek(new Date()));
    const weekFreeSlots = computeFreeSlots(events, weekStartKey, 7);
    const freeHoursThisWeek = Math.round(
      (weekFreeSlots.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.endMin - x.startMin), 0) / 60) * 10,
    ) / 10;

    const resp = await fetch("/api/advise", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        goal: {
          title: goal.title,
          deadline: goal.deadline ?? "",
          hoursPerWeek: goal.hoursPerWeek ?? 10,
          priority: goal.priority ?? "中",
        },
        context: {
          today,
          freeHoursThisWeek,
          weeksUntilDeadline: weeksUntil(today, goal.deadline ?? ""),
          existingTitles: events.map((e) => e.title),
        },
      }),
    });
    const json = (await resp.json()) as { ok?: boolean; error?: string; ... };
    if (!json.ok) {
      setGoalPlanError(json.error ?? "方案咨询失败，请稍后重试");
      return;
    }
    setAdvise({ goal, result: json });
  } catch {
    setGoalPlanError("方案咨询失败，请检查网络后重试");
  } finally {
    setAdvisingGoalId(null);
  }
};
```

```ts
  // 第一步：方案咨询。只出思路，不出事件；选定方案后再走 runGoalPlan 出事件。
  const handleGoalPlan = async (goal: Goal) => {
    if (planningGoalId || advisingGoalId) return;
    setAdvisingGoalId(goal.id);
    setGoalPlanError("");
    setGoalPlanNotice("");

    try {
      const today = dateKey(new Date());
      const weekFreeSlots = computeFreeSlots(events, dateKey(startOfWeek(new Date())), 7);
      const freeHoursThisWeek = Math.round(
        (weekFreeSlots.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.endMin - x.startMin), 0) / 60) * 10,
      ) / 10;

      const resp = await fetch("/api/advise", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          goal: {
            title: goal.title,
            deadline: goal.deadline ?? "",
            hoursPerWeek: goal.hoursPerWeek ?? 10,
            priority: goal.priority ?? "中",
          },
          context: {
            today,
            freeHoursThisWeek,
            weeksUntilDeadline: weeksUntil(today, goal.deadline ?? ""),
            existingTitles: events.map((e) => e.title),
          },
        }),
      });
      const json = (await resp.json()) as {
        ok?: boolean;
        error?: string;
        feasibility?: AdviseResult["feasibility"];
        options?: AdviseOption[];
        recommendation?: AdviseResult["recommendation"];
        recommendReason?: string;
      };
      if (!json.ok) {
        setGoalPlanError(json.error ?? "方案咨询失败，请稍后重试");
        return;
      }

      const options: AdviseOption[] = Array.isArray(json.options) ? json.options : [];
      if (options.length === 0) {
        setGoalPlanError("未得到可用方案，请重试");
        return;
      }
      setAdvise({
        goal,
        result: {
          feasibility: json.feasibility ?? {
            verdict: "可行",
            requiredHours: 0,
            supplyHours: 0,
            gapHours: 0,
            note: "",
          },
          options,
          recommendation: json.recommendation ?? options[0].id,
          recommendReason: json.recommendReason ?? "",
        },
      });
    } catch {
      setGoalPlanError("方案咨询失败，请检查网络后重试");
    } finally {
      setAdvisingGoalId(null);
    }
  };

  // 第二步：选定方案后，用 /api/goal 生成具体事件（重步骤）。
  const runGoalPlan = async (goal: Goal, strategy?: AdviseOption) => {
    if (planningGoalId) return;
    setPlanningGoalId(goal.id);
    setGoalPlanError("");
    setGoalPlanNotice("");

    try {
      // 未来 14 天的空档：今天起算，白天 08:00-23:00，碎片 ≥30 分钟。
      const freeSlots = computeFreeSlots(events, dateKey(new Date()), 14);
      const existingTitles = events.map((e) => e.title);

      const resp = await fetch("/api/goal", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          goal: {
            title: goal.title,
            deadline: goal.deadline ?? "",
            hoursPerWeek: goal.hoursPerWeek ?? 10,
            priority: goal.priority ?? "中",
          },
          freeSlots,
          existingTitles,
          today: dateKey(new Date()),
          strategy: strategy
            ? {
                name: strategy.name,
                summary: strategy.summary,
                sessionsPerWeek: strategy.sessionsPerWeek,
                avgSessionMin: strategy.avgSessionMin,
              }
            : undefined,
        }),
      });
      const json = (await resp.json()) as {
        ok?: boolean;
        error?: string;
        feasible?: boolean;
        advice?: string;
        reason?: string;
        movedCount?: number;
        droppedCount?: number;
        actions?: unknown;
      };
      if (!json.ok) {
        setGoalPlanError(json.error ?? "规划失败，请稍后重试");
        return;
      }

      const actions: PlanAction[] = ... (unchanged);
      setPlanPreview({...});
    } catch {
      setGoalPlanError("规划失败，请检查网络后重试");
    } finally {
      setPlanningGoalId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleSelectStrategy = (option: AdviseOption) => {
    if (!advise) return;
    const goal = advise.goal;
    setAdvise(null);
    void runGoalPlan(goal, option);
  };

  const handleCloseAdvise = () => setAdvise(null);
```

```
- requiredHours 是你估计的「达成该目标大致需要的总小时数」。估算时先想清楚「每周大概需要投入几小时」，再乘以 ${ctx.weeksUntilDeadline} 周；多数备考/学一门课的目标，requiredHours 和「每周投入 × 周数」是同一量级（本例可用总时长约 ${(ctx.hoursPerWeek * ctx.weeksUntilDeadline).toFixed(1)} 小时）。只有当目标特别宏大（例如一个月内学完三门专业课）时，requiredHours 才应明显超出可用总时长。

  · daily（分散式）：频率最高（每天），单次较短，记忆最牢但要求每天坚持；
  · weekly（集中式）：每周 2-3 次，单次最长，深入但间隔长易忘；
  · sprint（冲刺式）：前期频率低、后期频率高，单次时长中等。
- 三种方案的「每周总时长」必须都约为 ${ctx.hoursPerWeek} 小时（落在 ${weeklyLow}~${weeklyHigh} 小时之间）：即 sessionsPerWeek × avgSessionMin ÷ 60 应在此区间。例如每周 ${ctx.hoursPerWeek} 小时时，daily 可写 sessionsPerWeek=7、avgSessionMin=${dailyExampleMin}，weekly 可写 sessionsPerWeek=3、avgSessionMin=${weeklyExampleMin}。sessionsPerWeek 是 1-7 的整数，avgSessionMin 是 20-240 的整数。
- summary 用一句话（20-40 字）概括思路；pros 写 2-3 条优点；cons 写 2-3 条代价；risk 写一句话风险提示。
- recommendation 是三个方案里最推荐的一个 id；recommendReason 说明推荐理由（2-3 句）。如果时间明显不够，recommendReason 里必须给出三条可选的调整方向。
- 不要输出 verdict、note、totalHours 或任何时间点、日期、事件——这些由程序计算。
- 所有数字字段输出数字类型，不要加引号。
- 只输出上面这一个 JSON。
```

**User**

修识别的最后三件事。不要再用比例去算列，改成「模型判断 + 程序兜底 + 标记可疑」。

背景（实测）:
· 用 round 算列：星期 7/10；改成 Math.floor（数学上正确）：星期 5/10。
  原因：模型给的 leftRatio/rightRatio 系统性偏左约半列，且只偏一部分块；
  round 那个"多 +1"恰好补偿了它，所以反而更准。比例坐标不可靠。
· 节次：startSlot 普遍偏 1-2 行，跨度永远 1（模型数不出块占几行）。

【一】契约加回 colIndex 与 rowStart/rowEnd，比例仅作交叉校验
{
  "slotCount": number,
  "colCount": number,
  "periods": [...],
  "blocks": [{
    "name": string,
    "colIndex": number,     // 模型自己判断：第几列，1=周一 … 7=周日
    "rowStart": number,     // 模型自己判断：起始节次
    "rowEnd": number,       // 模型自己判断：结束节次，含两端
    "leftRatio": number,    // 保留：块中心相对表宽的比例，仅用于交叉校验
    "location": string,
    "weeks": string
  }]
}
提示词要点：
- colIndex 优先用表头文字判定（一/二/…/日），忽略表头里的日期数字。
- rowStart/rowEnd 看左侧节次编号；若某块明显占到多行，endSlot 要相应增大。
- leftRatio 只填一个数：块中心的横向比例（0..1），用于程序校验你的 colIndex。
- 只输出这一个 JSON。

【二】lib/blocksToCourses.ts 改为「判断优先、兜底、标可疑」
1. col 的确定顺序：
   a. 若 colIndex 在 1..colCount 内 -> 用它作为 col
   b. 若 colIndex 缺失或非法 -> 回退到 leftRatio：
      col = clamp(floor(leftRatio * colCount) + 1, 1, colCount)
   c. 若 colIndex 合法且 leftRatio 也给了：
      计算 ratioCol = clamp(floor(leftRatio * colCount) + 1, 1, colCount)；
      若 |ratioCol - colIndex| >= 2 -> 该 block 标 suspect（两者严重矛盾），仍用 colIndex
2. 节次的确定：
   a. 若 rowEnd >= rowStart 且 rowEnd > rowStart -> 用模型的跨度
   b. 若 rowEnd === rowStart（模型没读出高度）-> endSlot = startSlot + 1（不超过 slotCount），
      并标 suspect
   c. rowStart 缺失 -> 丢弃并计入 invalidCount
3. Course 增加 suspect?: boolean
4. 返回 { courses, invalidCount, suspectCount }
5. 若 colCount 不在 6..7：直接返回错误（见下一条），不夹取

【三】colCount 非法时返回 422，不要静默压列
- route.ts：若 colCount 不在 6..7 -> HTTP 422
  { ok:false, error:"课表列数识别异常（识别到 N 列），请换一张更清晰的截图或改用手动录入" }

【四】前端校对表格标黄可疑行
- ImportTimetable：rows 里 suspect 为 true 的行，整行背景 bg-amber-50，
  并在「星期」「结束节」两列标题加一个小提示「黄色行请核对」
- 保留 spanSuspect 的整体提示（若所有课跨度都为 1）

验收（必须给数字）:
□ npm run build 通过
□ 重抓用例：npm run eval:run -- "课表图片路径" final1
□ npm run eval:compare eval/cases/final1.json
□ 期望：课程名 10/10、地点 10/10、星期 >= 7/10、节次跨度 >= 5/10
□ 校对表里应能看到 3-5 行黄色
□ 若 colCount 识别为 8 或 5，接口返回 422 且文案清楚

```ts
  setQuickAdd(null);
  setQuickAddNotice("");
  setFlashIds([id]);

};
```

```ts
const handleGoalDelete = (id: string) => {
  const goal = goals.find((g) => g.id === id);
  const orphanCount = events.filter((e) => e.goalId === id).length;
  let msg = `确定删除目标「${goal?.title ?? ""}」吗？`;
  if (orphanCount > 0) {
    msg += ` 将同时移除 ${orphanCount} 个计划任务。`;
  }
  if (!window.confirm(msg)) return;

  const nextGoals = goals.filter((g) => g.id !== id);
  setGoals(nextGoals);
  saveGoals(nextGoals);

  if (orphanCount > 0) {
    const nextEvents = events.filter((e) => e.goalId !== id);
    commitEvents(nextEvents, `删除目标「${goal?.title ?? ""}」及其任务`);
  }
};
```

Let me define the merge helper. The recognize returns `periods: { slot, start, end }[]`. I want to produce a `Period[]` where index = slot-1.

```ts
function mergePeriods(
  recognized: { slot: number; start: string; end: string }[],
  slotsPerDay: number,
): Period[] {
  // 以默认作息为基底，长度取 slotsPerDay（至少 1）。
  const count = Math.max(1, Math.round(slotsPerDay) || DEFAULT_PERIODS.length);
  const arr: Period[] = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const d = DEFAULT_PERIODS[i];
    return d ? { ...d } : { start: "", end: "" };
  });
  for (const p of recognized) {
    const idx = Math.round(p.slot) - 1;
    if (idx >= 0 && idx < arr.length && p.start && p.end) {
      arr[idx] = { start: p.start, end: p.end };
    }
  }
  return arr;
}
```

Wait, but `slotsPerDay` could be up to 30, and DEFAULT_PERIODS has 11 entries. For slots beyond 11, `DEFAULT_PERIODS[i]` is undefined → use `{ start: "", end: "" }`. That's fine (empty means unknown).

But actually, `slotsPerDay` might be smaller than 11. E.g., a school with 5 periods. Then count = 5, arr has 5 entries. slotToRange with slot > 5 clamps to last entry (idx = min(slot-1, 4)). That's existing behavior.

But there's a subtle issue: `slotToRange` uses `list.length - 1` for clamping. If count is 5 but the course has startSlot up to 12 (clampSlot allows up to 12), slotToRange clamps to index 4 (period 5). That's fine — same as before with DEFAULT (11 entries, slot 12 clamps to index 10).

```ts
// lib/llm.ts

export type LlmErrorKind = ... 

export class LlmError extends Error {
  status: number;
  constructor(message: string, status = 500) {
    super(message);
    this.status = status;
  }
}

export function desensitize(text: string, key: string): string {
  if (!key) return text;
  return text.split(key).join("***");
}

export function parseLoose(raw: string): unknown {
  const start = raw.indexOf("{");
  const end = raw.lastIndexOf("}");
  if (start === -1 || end === -1 || end <= start) {
    throw new LlmError("JSON 解析失败：模型未返回可用的 JSON");
  }
  return JSON.parse(raw.slice(start, end + 1));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * 兼容 IPv6 简写（::1）与 IPv4。
 * 优先取 x-real-ip，其次取 XFF 的最后一段（离服务器最近的一跳），
 * 都取不到时退化为 "unknown"（所有未知来源共享一个桶，宁可误伤不可放开）。
 */
function getClientIp(req: Request): string {
  const real = req.headers.get("x-real-ip");
  if (real) return real.trim();
  const xff = req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for");
  if (xff) {
    const parts = xff.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length > 0) return parts[parts.length - 1];
  }
  return "unknown";
}

/** 滑动窗口限流：返回 null 表示放行，返回字符串表示拒绝原因。 */
function checkRateLimit(req: Request): string | null {
  if (IS_DEV) return null;
  const ip = getClientIp(req);
  const now = Date.now();
  const bucket = (rateBuckets.get(ip) ?? []).filter((t) => now - t < RATE_WINDOW_MS);
  if (bucket.length >= RATE_MAX) {
    rateBuckets.set(ip, bucket);
    return `安排过于频繁（每分钟最多 ${RATE_MAX} 次），请稍后再试`;
  }
  bucket.push(now);
  rateBuckets.set(ip, bucket);
  if (rateBuckets.size > 5000) {
    for (const [k, v] of rateBuckets) {
      if (v.every((t) => now - t >= RATE_WINDOW_MS)) rateBuckets.delete(k);
    }
  }
  return null;
}
```

【一】新增 lib/intent.ts（纯函数）
export function detectIntent(text: string): "schedule" | "goal"
规则（按顺序判断，第一条命中即返回）:
1. 若包含明确时间点 -> "schedule"
   正则参考：/(周|星期)[一二三四五六日天]|今天|明天|后天|大后天|下周/ 
   再叠加以下任一：数字+点/时/：|上午|下午|晚上|中午|早上
   例如「周三晚上7点复习高数」「明天下午3点开会」-> schedule
2. 若包含目标型词汇且没有具体时间 -> "goal"
   正则参考：/我要|我想|准备|考到|考上|学会|学完|目标|期末|期中|考试|一个月|一周内|每天|每周|提升|补|复习计划|想学/
   例如「我要学习高数的课程」「期末想把高数补到 80 分」-> goal
3. 其余默认 -> "goal"（宁可多问一句，也不要乱加事件）

【二】输入框提交时按意图分流

```ts
  const runPlan = async (text: string) => {
    setPlanStatus("loading");
    setPlanError("");
    setPlanReply("");

    const existingSummary = events.length
      ? events
          .map((e) => `- ${e.date} ${minutesToLabel(e.startMin)}-${minutesToLabel(e.endMin)} ${e.title}`)
          .join("\n")
      : "（暂无已安排的事件）";

    try {
      const resp = await fetch("/api/plan", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text,
          context: {
            today: dateKey(new Date()),
            weekStart: weekStartKey,
            weekEnd: weekEndKey,
            existing: existingSummary,
          },
        }),
      });
      const json = (await resp.json()) as {
        ok?: boolean;
        error?: string;
        actions?: unknown;
        reply?: unknown;
        droppedCount?: unknown;
      };
      if (!json.ok) {
        setPlanError(json.error ?? "安排失败，请稍后重试");
        return;
      }

      const { next, added } = executePlan(json.actions, eventsRef.current);
      commitEvents(next, "AI 安排事件");

      if (added.length > 0) {
        setFlashIds(added.map((e) => e.id));
        setTimeout(() => setFlashIds([]), 2000);
      }

      let reply = typeof json.reply === "string" ? json.reply : "";
      const droppedCount = typeof json.droppedCount === "number" ? json.droppedCount : 0;
      if (droppedCount > 0) {
        reply = `${reply}（已忽略 ${droppedCount} 条无法识别的安排）`;
      }
      setPlanReply(reply);

      setPlanText("");
      planInputRef.current?.focus();
    } catch {
      setPlanError("安排失败，请检查网络后重试");
    } finally {
      setPlanStatus("idle");
    }
  };

  const handlePlanSend = () => {
    const text = planText.trim();
    if (!text || planStatus === "loading") return;
    if (detectIntent(text) === "goal") {
      setClarify({ text });
      return;
    }
    void runPlan(text);
  };

  // 目标澄清卡 -> 让 AI 给方案：复用现有 advise 流程。
  const handleClarifyAdvise = (hoursPerWeek: number, deadline: string) => {
    if (!clarify) return;

    setClarify(null);
    void runPlan(text);
  };

  const handleClarifyClose = () => {
    setClarify(null);
  };
```

## 改动摘要

**新增 [intent.ts](file:///D:/Projects/timetable-plan/lib/intent.ts)** — `detectIntent(text)` 纯函数：

**新增 [GoalClarify.tsx](file:///D:/Projects/timetable-plan/app/components/GoalClarify.tsx)** — 目标澄清卡：标题「想达成这个目标：{原话}」、每周投入（默认 10，范围 1-40）、截止日期（默认 today+28 天）、「让 AI 给方案」/「只加一条事件」两个按钮、右下角小字提示。

**改 [page.tsx](file:///D:/Projects/timetable-plan/app/page.tsx)**：
- 新增 `clarify: { text: string } | null` 状态。
- 把原 `/api/plan` 逻辑抽成 `runPlan(text)`；`handlePlanSend` 现在先 `detectIntent` 分流：goal → 弹澄清卡（不清空输入框），schedule → 走原流程。
- 新增三个回调：`handleClarifyAdvise`（复用 `handleGoalPlan` 走 advise，原话作 `goal.title`）、`handleClarifyAddEvent`（走原 `/api/plan`）、`handleClarifyClose`（仅清 clarify，输入框保留）。
